我駐義大利大使許紹昌於義大利與我國斷交後返國，在機場舉行說明會。聯合報系資料照

2026-11-09 00:00 聯合報 ／ 記者杜建重整理

義大利外交部長在本月4日約見我駐義大利大使許紹昌，面交義大利定於11月6日下午4時（台北時間晚上11時）承認北平偽政權之備忘錄。許紹昌大使當即將我方備忘錄遞交義大利表示抗議。

### 一整年的深度陪伴

*   11/17前訂閱，抽 Apple Watch Series 12。
*   每天2.4元，讀懂新聞背後的關鍵。
*   深度報導、趨勢分析，重要議題持續掌握。

## [歷史上的今天／1959年警總破獲千萬走私案 21人落網](https://vip.udn.com/vip/story/122884/9855911?from=vipudn_content_series "歷史上的今天／1959年警總破獲千萬走私案 21人落網")

[1959年11月5日，台灣警備總司令部清晨在基隆三沙灣公路上破獲大規模走私集團，逮捕主從疑犯陳萬、林萬福等21名，查獲價值新台幣1千萬元的毛質西裝料94大綑。此私集團的運輸工具有貨運卡車、旅行轎車、航行船隻等。組成份子包括布疋商、委託商、雜貨商、青果商、碼頭工人、捕魚者及汽車司機等。陳、林兩名主疑犯，並曾腰纏萬餘美金偷渡出境。此私集團規模之龐大，為本省光復以來所罕見。該案是否尚有幕後主持人，或另走私其他物品，警備總部繼續擴大偵查中。](https://vip.udn.com/vip/story/122884/9855911?from=vipudn_content_series "歷史上的今天／1959年警總破獲千萬走私案 21人落網")

## [歷史上的今天／1960年美鋼琴家塞爾金來台 中山堂獻藝](https://vip.udn.com/vip/story/122884/9853468?from=vipudn_content_series "歷史上的今天／1960年美鋼琴家塞爾金來台 中山堂獻藝")

[1960年11月4日，美國鋼琴家魯道夫塞爾金（Rdolf Serkin），晚上8時在中山堂第一場演奏會中，用他的琴韻，使滿座聽眾陶醉流連。塞爾金不愧是世界第一流的鋼琴家，中山堂那台年齡已不算小的鋼琴，在塞爾金的手下，竟出落得聲如金石，不同凡響。塞爾金的臉上閃爍著被音樂充滿了情緒，也使聽眾們沐浴在音韻中。](https://vip.udn.com/vip/story/122884/9853468?from=vipudn_content_series "歷史上的今天／1960年美鋼琴家塞爾金來台 中山堂獻藝")

## [9月希臘航展F-4E墜毀釀2死 愛琴海幽靈折翼](https://vip.udn.com/vip/story/122151/9853976?from=vipudn_content_recommendation "9月希臘航展F-4E墜毀釀2死 愛琴海幽靈折翼")

2026-11-05 07:30:00

[希臘塔納格拉基地航展驚傳墜機意外，F-4E戰機起飛表演後，突然失控墜地爆炸，兩名飛行員殉職，原本盛大的航空盛會被迫中止。事故發生後，希臘軍方緊急停飛同型戰機，展開全面調查。 2026年雅典航空周航空展9月5日在塔納格拉（Tanagra）基地展開。這場南歐最盛大航展，因第一天下午F-4E表演機墜地爆炸，嘎然而止，讓所有觀眾留下遺憾。 航展因意外草草收場，但是航展開幕前一日主辦單位安排媒體體驗幾乎所有表演科目。本篇獻給兩位殉職飛行員，感謝他們過去駕駛這架經典戰機，帶給觀眾的驚艷表演，斯人已遠，精神永在。](https://vip.udn.com/vip/story/122151/9853976?from=vipudn_content_recommendation "9月希臘航展F-4E墜毀釀2死 愛琴海幽靈折翼")

2026-10-28 10:30:00

Department of Commerce International Trade Administration
Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, Department of Commerce.
Applicable November 4, 2026.
Kayden Jenson, Office II, AD/CVD Operations, Enforcement and Compliance, International Trade Administration, U.S. Department of Commerce, 1401 Constitution Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20230; telephone: (202) 482-0967.
On October 15, 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce (Commerce) received a countervailing duty (CVD) petition concerning imports of seamless carbon and alloy steel standard, line, and pressure pipe (seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe) from India, filed in proper form on behalf of Tenaris USA (Tenaris), Vallourec Star LP (Vallourec), and the United Steel, Paper and Forestry, Rubber, Manufacturing, Energy, Allied Industrial and Service Workers International Union, AFL-CIO, CLC (USW) (collectively, the petitioners), domestic producers of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe and a certified union, which represents workers engaged in the production of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe in the United States.[1] The CVD Petition was accompanied by antidumping duty (AD) petitions concerning imports of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from Georgia and India.[2]
Between October 20 and 26, 2026, Commerce requested supplemental information pertaining to certain aspects of the Petition in supplemental questionnaires.[3] Between October 22 and 28, 2026, the petitioners filed timely responses to these requests for additional information.[4]
In accordance with section 702(b)(1) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended (the Act), the petitioners allege that the Government of India (GOI) is providing countervailable subsidies, within the meaning of sections 701 and 771(5) of the Act, to producers of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India, and that such imports are materially injuring, or threatening material injury to, the domestic industry producing seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe in the United States. Consistent with section 702(b)(1) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.202(b), for those alleged programs on which we are initiating a CVD investigation, the Petition was accompanied by information reasonably available to the petitioners supporting their allegations.
Commerce finds that the petitioners filed the Petition on behalf of the domestic industry, because the petitioners are interested parties, as defined in sections 771(9)(C) and (D) of the Act.[5] Commerce also finds that the petitioners demonstrated sufficient industry support with respect to the initiation of the requested CVD investigation.[6]
Because the Petition was filed on October 15, 2026, the POI is January 1, 2025, through December 31, 2025.[7]
The product covered by this investigation is seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India. For a full description of the scope of this investigation, see the appendix to this notice.
Comments on the Scope of the Investigation
On October 20 and 26, 2026, Commerce requested information and clarification from the petitioners regarding the proposed scope to ensure that the scope language in the Petition is an accurate reflection of the products for which the domestic industry is seeking relief.[8] On October 22 and 28, 2026, the petitioners provided clarifications and revised the scope.[9] The description of merchandise covered by this investigation, as described in the appendix to this notice, reflects these clarifications.
As discussed in the Preamble to Commerce's regulations, we are setting ( printed page 70848) aside a period for interested parties to raise issues regarding product coverage ( i.e., scope).[10] Commerce will consider all scope comments received from interested parties and, if necessary, will consult with interested parties prior to the issuance of the preliminary determination. If scope comments include factual information, all such factual information should be limited to public information.[11] Commerce requests that interested parties provide at the beginning of their scope comments a public executive summary for each comment or issue raised in their submission. Commerce further requests that interested parties limit their public executive summary of each comment or issue to no more than 450 words, not including citations. Commerce intends to use the public executive summaries as the basis of the comment summaries included in the analysis of scope comments. To facilitate preparation of its questionnaires, Commerce requests that scope comments be submitted by 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time (ET) on November 24, 2026, which is 20 calendar days from the signature date of this notice. Any rebuttal comments, which may include factual information, and should also be limited to public information, must be filed by 5:00 p.m. ET on December 4, 2026, which is 10 calendar days from the initial comment deadline.
Commerce requests that any factual information that parties consider relevant to the scope of this investigation be submitted during that period. However, if a party subsequently finds that additional factual information pertaining to the scope of the investigation may be relevant, the party must contact Commerce and request permission to submit the additional information. All scope comments must be filed simultaneously on the records of the concurrent AD and CVD investigations.
All submissions to Commerce must be filed electronically via Enforcement and Compliance's Antidumping Duty and Countervailing Duty Centralized Electronic Service System (ACCESS), unless an exception applies.[12] An electronically filed document must be received successfully in its entirety by the time and date it is due.
Pursuant to sections 702(b)(4)(A)(i) and (ii) of the Act, Commerce notified the GOI of the receipt of the Petition and provided an opportunity for consultations with respect to the Petition.[13] Commerce held consultations with the GOI on November 3, 2026.[14]
Determination of Industry Support for the Petition
Section 702(b)(1) of the Act requires that a petition be filed on behalf of the domestic industry. Section 702(c)(4)(A) of the Act provides that a petition meets this requirement if the domestic producers or workers who support the petition account for: (i) at least 25 percent of the total production of the domestic like product; and (ii) more than 50 percent of the production of the domestic like product produced by that portion of the industry expressing support for, or opposition to, the petition. Moreover, section 702(c)(4)(D) of the Act provides that, if the petition does not establish support of domestic producers or workers accounting for more than 50 percent of the total production of the domestic like product, Commerce shall: (i) poll the industry or rely on other information in order to determine if there is support for the petition, as required by subparagraph (A); or (ii) determine industry support using a statistically valid sampling method to poll the “industry.”
Section 771(4)(A) of the Act defines the “industry” as the producers as a whole of a domestic like product. Thus, to determine whether a petition has the requisite industry support, the statute directs Commerce to look to producers and workers who produce the domestic like product. The U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC), which is responsible for determining whether “the domestic industry” has been injured, must also determine what constitutes a domestic like product in order to define the industry. While both Commerce and the ITC apply the same statutory definition regarding the domestic like product,[15] they do so for different purposes and pursuant to a separate and distinct authority. In addition, Commerce's determination is subject to limitations of time and information. Although this may result in different definitions of the like product, such differences do not render the decision of either agency contrary to law.[16]
Section 771(10) of the Act defines the domestic like product as “a product which is like, or in the absence of like, most similar in characteristics and uses with, the article subject to an investigation under this title.” Thus, the reference point from which the domestic like product analysis begins is “the article subject to an investigation” ( i.e., the class or kind of merchandise to be investigated, which normally will be the scope as defined in the petition).
With regard to the domestic like product, the petitioners do not offer a definition of the domestic like product distinct from the scope of the investigation.[17] Based on our analysis of the information submitted on the record, we have determined that seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe, as defined in the scope, constitutes a single domestic like product, and we have analyzed industry support in terms of that domestic like product.[18]
In determining whether the petitioners have standing under section 702(c)(4)(A) of the Act, we considered the industry support data contained in the Petition with reference to the domestic like product as defined in the “Scope of the Investigation,” in the appendix to this notice. To establish industry support, the petitioners provided the 2025 shipments of the domestic like product for the U.S. producers that support the Petitions, and compared this to the estimated total 2025 shipments of the domestic like ( printed page 70849) product for the entire domestic industry.[19] Because total production data for the domestic like product for 2025 are not reasonably available to the petitioners, and the petitioners have established that shipments are a reasonable proxy for production data,[20] we relied on data provided by the petitioners for purposes of measuring industry support.[21]
Our review of the data provided in the Petition, the First General Issues Supplement, and other information readily available to Commerce indicates that the petitioners have established industry support for the Petition.[22] First, the Petition established support from domestic producers and supporters accounting for more than 50 percent of the total production of the domestic like product and, as such, Commerce is not required to take further action in order to evaluate industry support ( e.g., polling).[23] Second, the domestic producers and supporters have met the statutory criteria for industry support under section 702(c)(4)(A)(i) of the Act because the domestic producers and supporters who support the Petition account for at least 25 percent of the total production of the domestic like product.[24] Finally, the domestic producers and supporters have met the statutory criteria for industry support under section 702(c)(4)(A)(ii) of the Act because the domestic producers and supporters who support the Petition account for more than 50 percent of the production of the domestic like product produced by that portion of the industry expressing support for, or opposition to, the Petition.[25] Accordingly, Commerce determines that the Petition was filed on behalf of the domestic industry within the meaning of section 702(b)(1) of the Act.[26]
Because India is a “Subsidies Agreement Country” within the meaning of section 701(b) of the Act, section 701(a)(2) of the Act applies to this investigation. Accordingly, the ITC must determine whether imports of the subject merchandise from India materially injure, or threaten material injury to, a U.S. industry.
Allegations and Evidence of Material Injury and Causation
The petitioners allege that imports of the subject merchandise are benefiting from countervailable subsidies and that such imports are causing, or threaten to cause, material injury to the U.S. industry producing the domestic like product. In addition, the petitioners allege that subject imports exceed the negligibility threshold provided for under section 771(24)(A) of the Act.[27]
The petitioners contend that the industry's injured condition is illustrated by a significant increase in the volume of subject imports; underselling and price depression and/or suppression; negative impact on financial performance; and declines in production, U.S. shipments, and employment variables.[28] We assessed the allegations and supporting evidence regarding material injury, threat of material injury, causation, as well as negligibility, and we have determined that these allegations are properly supported by adequate evidence, and meet the statutory requirements for initiation.[29]
Based upon the examination of the Petition and supplemental responses, we find that they meet the requirements of section 702 of the Act. Therefore, we are initiating a CVD investigation to determine whether imports of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India benefit from countervailable subsidies conferred by the GOI. In accordance with section 703(b)(1) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.205(b)(1), unless postponed, we will make our preliminary determination no later than 65 days after the date of this initiation.
Based on our review of the Petition, we find that there is sufficient information to initiate a CVD investigation on 24 programs alleged by the petitioners. For a full discussion of the basis for our decision to initiate on each program, see the India CVD Initiation Checklist. A public version of the initiation checklist for this investigation is available on ACCESS.
In the Petition, the petitioners identified 16 companies in India.[30] Commerce intends to follow its standard practice in CVD investigations and calculate company-specific subsidy rates in this investigation. In the event that Commerce determines that the number of companies is large and it cannot individually examine each company based on Commerce's resources, where appropriate, Commerce intends to select mandatory respondents based on quantity and value (Q&V) questionnaires issued to the potential respondents. Commerce normally selects mandatory respondents in CVD investigations using U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) entry data for U.S. imports under the appropriate Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) subheadings listed in the “Scope of the Investigation,” in the appendix. However, for this investigation, some of the main HTSUS subheadings under which the subject merchandise would enter (7304.19.1020, 7304.19.1030, 7304.19.1045, 7304.19.1060, 7304.19.5020, 7304.19.5050, 7304.31.6050, 7304.39.0016, 7304.39.0020, 7304.39.0024, 7304.39.0028, 7304.39.0032, 7304.39.0036, 7304.39.0040, 7304.39.0044, 7304.39.0048, 7304.39.0052, 7304.39.0056, 7304.39.0062, 7304.39.0068, 7304.39.0072, 7304.51.5005, 7304.51.5060, 7304.59.6000) are basket categories under which non-subject merchandise may also enter. Therefore, instead of relying on CBP entry data in selecting respondents, we intend to issue Q&V questionnaires to each potential respondent for which there is complete address information on the record.
Commerce will post the Q&V questionnaire along with filing instructions on Commerce's website at https://www.trade.gov/​ec-adcvd-qv-questionnaire. Producers/exporters of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India that do not receive Q&V questionnaires may still submit a response to the Q&V questionnaire and can obtain a copy of the Q&V questionnaire from Commerce's website. Responses to the Q&V questionnaire must be submitted by the relevant Indian producers/exporters no later than 5:00 p.m. ET on November 18, 2026, which is two weeks from the signature date of this notice. All Q&V questionnaire responses must be filed electronically via ACCESS. An ( printed page 70850) electronically filed document must be received successfully, in its entirety, by ACCESS no later than 5:00 p.m. ET on the deadline noted above.
Interested parties must submit applications for disclosure under administrative protective order (APO) in accordance with 19 CFR 351.305(b). Instructions for filing such applications may be found on Commerce's website at https://www.trade.gov/​administrative-protective-orders.
In accordance with section 702(b)(4)(A) of the Act and 19 CFR 351.202(f), a copy of the public version of the Petition has been provided to the GOI via ACCESS. To the extent practicable, we will attempt to provide a copy of the public version of the Petition to each exporter named in the Petition, as provided under 19 CFR 351.203(c)(2).
Commerce will notify the ITC of its initiation, as required by section 702(d) of the Act.
The ITC will preliminarily determine, within 45 days after the date on which the Petition was filed, whether there is a reasonable indication that imports of seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe from India are materially injuring, or threatening material injury to, a U.S. industry.[31] A negative ITC determination will result in the investigation being terminated.[32] Otherwise, this CVD investigation will proceed according to statutory and regulatory time limits.
Factual information is defined in 19 CFR 351.102(b)(21) as: (i) evidence submitted in response to questionnaires; (ii) evidence submitted in support of allegations; (iii) publicly available information to value factors of production under 19 CFR 351.408(c) or to measure the adequacy of remuneration under 19 CFR 351.511(a)(2); (iv) evidence placed on the record by Commerce; and (v) evidence other than factual information described in (i)-(iv). Section 351.301(b) of Commerce's regulations requires any party, when submitting factual information, to specify under which subsection of 19 CFR 351.102(b)(21) the information is being submitted [33] and, if the information is submitted to rebut, clarify, or correct factual information already on the record, to provide an explanation identifying the information already on the record that the factual information seeks to rebut, clarify, or correct.[34] Time limits for the submission of factual information are addressed in 19 CFR 351.301, which provides specific time limits based on the type of factual information being submitted. Interested parties should review the regulations prior to submitting factual information in this investigation.
Parties may request an extension of time limits before the expiration of a time limit established under 19 CFR 351.301, or as otherwise specified by Commerce. In general, an extension request will be considered untimely if it is filed after the expiration of the time limit established under 19 CFR 351.301, or as otherwise specified by Commerce.[35] For submissions that are due from multiple parties simultaneously, an extension request will be considered untimely if it is filed after 10:00 a.m. ET on the due date. Under certain circumstances, Commerce may elect to specify a different time limit by which extension requests will be considered untimely for submissions which are due from multiple parties simultaneously. In such a case, we will inform parties in a letter or memorandum of the deadline (including a specified time) by which extension requests must be filed to be considered timely. An extension request must be made in a separate, standalone submission; under limited circumstances we will grant untimely filed requests for the extension of time limits, where we determine, based on 19 CFR 351.302, that extraordinary circumstances exist. Parties should review Commerce's regulations concerning the extension of time limits and the Time Limits Final Rule prior to submitting factual information in this investigation.[36]
Any party submitting factual information in an AD or CVD proceeding must certify to the accuracy and completeness of that information.[37] Parties must use the certification formats provided in 19 CFR 351.303(g).[38] Commerce intends to reject factual submissions if the submitting party does not comply with the applicable certification requirements.
Interested parties must submit applications for disclosure under APO in accordance with 19 CFR 351.305. Parties wishing to participate in this investigation should ensure that they meet the requirements of 19 CFR 351.103(d) ( e.g., by filing the required letters of appearance). Note that Commerce has amended certain of its requirements pertaining to the service of documents in 19 CFR 351.303(f).[39]
This notice is issued and published pursuant to sections 702 and 777(i) of the Act, and 19 CFR 351.203(c).
Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary for Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Operations.
The merchandise covered by this investigation is seamless carbon and alloy steel (other than stainless steel) pipes and redraw hollows, less than or equal to 16 inches (406.4 mm) in nominal outside diameter, regardless of wall-thickness, manufacturing process ( e.g., hot finished or cold-drawn), end finish ( e.g., plain end, beveled end, upset end, threaded, or threaded and coupled), or surface finish ( e.g., bare, lacquered or coated). Redraw hollows are any unfinished carbon or alloy steel (other than stainless steel) pipe or “hollow profiles” suitable for cold finishing operations, such as cold drawing, to meet the American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) or American Petroleum Institute (API) specifications referenced below, or comparable specifications. Specifically included within the scope are seamless carbon and alloy steel (other than stainless steel) standard, line, and pressure pipes produced to the ASTM A-53, ASTM A-106, ASTM A-333, ASTM A-334, ASTM A-589, ASTM A-795, ASTM A-1024, and the API 5L specifications, or comparable specifications, and meeting the physical parameters described above, regardless of application, with the exception of the exclusions discussed below.
Specifically excluded from the scope of this investigation are: (1) all pipes meeting ( printed page 70851) aerospace, hydraulic, and bearing tubing specifications, including: (a) aerospace tubing produced to SAE Aerospace Material Specifications (AMS) 6360, 6361, and 6362; (b) hydraulic tubing produced to ASTM A-822, SAE J524, and EN 10305-4 specifications; and (c) bearing tubing produced to the SAE AMS 6440 specification, including bearing tubing manufactured from steel meeting the chemical and metallurgical requirements of ASTM A-295; (2) all pipes meeting the chemical requirements of ASTM A-335, whether finished or unfinished; (3) unattached couplings; (4) all mechanical, boiler, condenser and heat exchange tubing, except when such products conform to the dimensional requirements, i.e., outside diameter and wall thickness, of ASTM A-53, ASTM A-106 or API 5L specifications; (5) oil country tubular goods consisting of drill pipe, casing, tubing, and coupling stock; and (6) all pipes meeting the chemical requirements of ASTM A-335 regardless of their conformity to the dimensional requirements of ASTM A-53, ASTM A-106 or API 5L.
Subject seamless standard, line, and pressure pipe are normally entered under Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS) subheadings 7304.19.1020, 7304.19.1030, 7304.19.1045, 7304.19.1060, 7304.19.5020, 7304.19.5050, 7304.31.6050, 7304.39.0016, 7304.39.0020, 7304.39.0024, 7304.39.0028, 7304.39.0032, 7304.39.0036, 7304.39.0040, 7304.39.0044, 7304.39.0048, 7304.39.0052, 7304.39.0056, 7304.39.0062, 7304.39.0068, 7304.39.0072, 7304.51.5005, 7304.51.5060, 7304.59.6000, 7304.59.8010, 7304.59.8015, 7304.59.8020, 7304.59.8025, 7304.59.8030, 7304.59.8035, 7304.59.8040, 7304.59.8045, 7304.59.8050, 7304.59.8055, 7304.59.8060, 7304.59.8065, and 7304.59.8070. Subject merchandise may also enter under HTSUS subheadings 7304.31.6010, 7304.39.0002, 7304.39.0004, 7304.39.0006, 7304.39.0008, 7304.51.5015, 7304.51.5045, 7304.59.2030, 7304.59.2040, 7304.59.2045, 7304.59.2055, and 7304.59.2060. The HTSUS subheadings and specifications are provided for convenience and customs purposes; the written description of the scope is dispositive.

content:
Fundraiser by Heather Liu : Help A #MeToo Survivor and Daughter Win Their Case
Heather Liu is organizing this fundraiser.
What I’ve experienced isn’t what any woman should ever go through. First there was the violence of non-consensual sex forced on me, followed by lies and denial. Then, rare moments of hope, followed by setbacks tinged with revenge from a father whose fear of revealing truth drives him to deny his child’s existence. This child is my daughter. For 20 years I’ve hidden the nightmare involving her origin by my silence, partly due to the sense of shame and partly because the father of my child is a influential public figure. Till the rapist has pushed us to a corner by threatening our existence with vicious conspiracy theories.
（我經歷了任何一位女性都不該經歷的事情。先是遭遇性侵，接著還要面對謊言、抵賴和詆毀。過去20年來，間或閃現的希望，卻因我女兒的生父拒絕承認這孩子的存在，而淹沒在長久的幻滅中。過去20年來，我一直對女兒的身世三緘其口，讓一段揮之不去的夢魘深藏內心，一方面出於羞辱感，另一方面無法面對孩子的生父作為一個公眾人物給我心靈帶來的扭曲。）
With your help, the truth of our experience will be told. When it is, I hope justice will prevail. This is why I’m emerging from the shadows.
（因您伸出援手，我將得以說出這段真實的經歷。當真相大白的那一天到來，我希望正義能夠隨之彰顯。）
In 2000, I was a journalist working for a local Chinese newspaper in Los Angeles. I was assigned to interview a famous Chinese dissident, a political refugee in America, who people called the “Godfather of the Democratic Movement in China.” I wrote the story, but in doing so, my life was changed forever by his sexual assault of me.
（2000年，身為洛杉磯當地一家中文媒體記者的我，被派去採訪一位著名的中國異議人士，也是我本人非常敬仰的政治流亡者、一位被視為「中國民主運動之父」的風雲人物。我完成了採訪任務，然而我的個人生活卻因今生與他這唯一的遭逢而徹底脫軌。）
Let’s just say, nine months after I did that story, I gave birth to my daughter, who bore no resemblance to my then-husband. My husband knew why since I’d told him about the sexual assault after it happened. My marriage ended, and my life as a single mom began. To protect my daughter and me from possible backlash about how she was conceived and her father’s identity, I kept my ordeal quiet. The two of us moved to Hong Kong.
（在我做了那次採訪的9個月之後，我的女兒降生了。她跟我當時的丈夫長得一點也不像，而我丈夫也並不感到驚訝，因為我早跟他坦白了我遭遇性侵的事。我的婚姻其實從那時起已名存實亡，我作為一個單親母親的生涯也即將開始。為了遠離各種因孩子身世而產生的猜忌，讓我和孩子可以過安靜而屬於自己的生活，同時也為了可以就近得到父母家人的幫忙照顧，我帶著孩子離開了美國，赴香港尋找發展機會。）
Through the years I never thought about contacting my daughter's biological father, whom I met only once. I didn’t consider doing this even after I lost my job as an editor in 2012. But then a former colleague, Beifeng, left Hong Kong for the United States. He’d criticized me for "depriving the child the right to be recognized by her father," and later persuaded me to let him bring a lock of my daughter’s hair, wrapped it in tissue paper, that he took with him to the United States.
（多年來，我從未想過要聯絡孩子的生父，那個我只見過一面的人，哪怕是2012年我失業的時候也沒萌生這個打算。我根本已經忘記了這個人，要不是當時正要動身赴美的前同事北風（我告訴了他我的孩子生父是誰，但沒有讓他知道詳情，他也沒有探問）批評我「剝奪孩子認父的權利」。他太太當即揪了孩子幾根頭髮，用手紙包了起來。）
Months later, my heart sank when Beifeng reported back to me that this man had denied everything, even the possibility of knowing me, let alone the possibility of having fathered a child. He’d committed this horrible crime against me, but he refused to acknowledge this truth. For to accept that he’d fathered a daughter, he’d have to admit how she came to existence. It appeared that he was refusing to allow his carefully crafted story about his “heroic” life to be marred by acknowledging his daughter’s existence.
（幾個月之後，北風帶來消息並深表意外地說，孩子的生父得知自己可能有個孩子時的反應，竟是敷衍和閃躲，好像根本不可能有這回事一樣。他當然寧肯忘記自己做過的事，但真相怎麼能因你不想面對就可以不承認、孩子怎麼可以就這樣當她不存在呢？就像他後來在郵件裡提到的，他所關切的，是這事將來在他的回憶錄裡該怎麼寫，而不是他身為人父應該盡什麼責。他在意的只是他自己英雄般的人生，無論如何不能留下任何污點。）
After this news reached me, I was diagnosed with clinical depression and started to see a doctor regularly. Professionally, however, I had to appear calm and collected so I could earn a living that would support the two of us. I worked as a freelance writer and translator, while also raising my daughter on my own.
（我聞訊心裡沉了一下，不久開始意識恍惚，甚至試過下班下車記不起回家的方向。我遠在北京的母親聽說之後，在電話的另一頭啜泣得聲音哽咽。2013年2月，我被確診患上抑鬱症。失業更兼病倒，令我們母女的生計雪上加霜，這期間我成為自由撰稿人，還要硬撐著努力譯書維持生計。好在偶爾有父母幫手、妹妹接濟一下，才度過了一段危機。）
Five years later, in 2018, in the midst of #MeToo movement, when sexual abuse and harassment were receiving public attention globally, rumors spread online about this famous Chinese man having fathered an illegitimate child. At that point, I contacted him by phone from Hong Kong and boldly asked for child support.
（一晃又過了5年，時間到了2018年，在#MeToo（「我也是受害者」）運動的聲浪中，性侵和性騷擾現象的普遍存在引起了全球性輿論關注。在此期間，網上首次出現了對我女兒的生父「不認親」的議論。已變得反應遲緩的我這才開始應對，邁出了主動聯繫孩子生父這一步。）
He agreed to a DNA test that was performed privately in Washington D.C.., The DNA results proved that he was Charlotte's father. The person who shared the results with him said that he had responded positively to having a daughter. Accordingly, when I contacted him again, he promised to assist us by at least paying for her education. But later on, since I would not change my tone on the unhappy encounter with him in the past, he decided to deny being Charlotte’s father and began to challenge the DNA results, shirked his responsibility as her biological father, and ignored that I was a victim of his violent sexual assault.
（他於是主動提出做個DNA鑑定，並指定了一位背景相當可靠的前白宮幕僚做中間人，在華盛頓特區進行了DNA樣本的收集與鑑定。結果出來後，中間人率先通知我，說結果證明魏先生是孩子的生父無疑，並告訴我，魏先生對鑑定結果表示認可並顯得「很開心」。據此，在我與孩子的生父再次聯繫時，他表示自己起碼會負擔孩子的大學學費。但真到了時候他又變卦了，甚至仗著沒有把DNA鑑定結果如約給我們，便想將已經做過DNA鑑定這事也想賴掉。）
The rest of the story is detailed in Huaizhao Liu v. Jingsheng Wei, case #1:19-cv-03344, which was heard in the Washington, D.C. federal court. Charlotte’s father managed to find the funds necessary to hire a high-powered defense attorney to help him to deny both our dignity and his basic obligations of paternity.
（後來的事情見華盛頓特區聯邦法院卷宗（Case Number 1:19-cv-03344）。我女兒的生父大手筆聘請了專攻白領犯罪辯護的名牌大狀為自己的辯護律師，竭力搬弄法律條文進行技術性規避，想就此永遠掩蓋真相，踐踏我們母女的權益與尊嚴。）
We believe that Charlotte’s biological father should be forced to keep his promise of supporting her education, and we are asking that he release the DNA test results to us. His 19-year old daughter deserves to know the truth.
（我們堅信，法庭應該為這位竭力否認已經做過親子鑑定的生父驗明正身，然後強制他履行他的諾言，承擔他女兒的學費。我們堅信，他19歲的女兒有權利知曉真相。）
The weight of evidence is on our side, but we risk losing the lawsuit that we are filing against him if we cannot raise the money we need to hire an attorney who is as capable as his lawyer. What is at risk is Charlotte's right to a quality education, along with the legally binding acknowledgement of his paternity.
（儘管我們掌握活生生的證據，但如果籌不到聘請律師的費用，單憑我們自訴，將無法應對複雜的陪審團庭審程序。立案至今一年多來，被告採取躲和拖的戰術，先是躲傳票，然後提出「司法管轄權」爭議逼我們撤案，一計不成又援引「多國籍」條款，將案子從特區高等法院轉移到聯邦法院。）
With your assistance – with your contributions – we intend to hire an attorney who is experienced in sexual assault and paternity cases. We hope to win this #MeToo case and pursue respectful, equal and democratic human relationship in Chinese community.
（您的捐助將幫助我們聘請到專攻性侵案和親子案官司的律師，幫我們贏得這場事關尊嚴、平等、人權以及人性的人身傷害官司，並藉此推動美國的華人社區乃至全球華人的觀念進步與行為的現代化。）
Here are some online stories and commentary about this, in Chinese:
https://www.storm.mg/article/2891777?mode=whole
(by Liao Yiwu, award winner of Human Rights Watch Hellman-Hammett Grant 2003, the German Geschwister-Scholl-Preis 2011 and the Peace Prize of the German Book Trade 2012.)
（作者/廖亦武，詩人、流亡作家與底層歷史記錄者。2012年德國書業和平獎得主，並曾獲美國《當代基督教》雜誌頒發的「最佳圖書奬」、德國書業協會頒發的「紹爾兄妹獎」、德國廣播協會頒發的「最佳廣播劇奬」及德國阿夏芬堡頒發的「公民勇氣奬」。2013年，法國政府頒發給廖亦武「法蘭西文學藝術軍官獎章」。2018年，廖亦武獲美國紐約瓦茨拉夫 哈維爾圖書基金會頒發「無懼危難作家獎」。）
http://minzhuzhongguo.org/MainArtShow.aspx?AID=105641
(by Qi JIazhen, writer in exile, author of autobiographical series: Tears of the Goddess of Liberty and Red Dog. Qi is the Chairwoman of the Women Writers committee, Independent Chinese PEN Center.)
（作者/齊家貞，流亡作家，著有系列傳記《自由神的眼泪──父女两代囚徒的真實故事》（後改名《黑牆裡的倖存者》和《紅狗：—個被釋女囚的真實故事》在香港和台灣出版。齊家貞曾先後擔任國際筆會獨立中文筆會理事會理事、副會長、秘書長等職務，並在澳洲建立了“齊氏文化基金會”，每年頒發“推動中國進步獎”截至2019年已連續頒獎12屆。）
https://liuvswei.blogspot.com/2020/08/metoo.html
(by Lau Kayee, Chairwoman of Network for Women In Politics, Hong Kong; Spokeswoman of Hong Kong Civil Human Rights Front.)
（作者/劉家儀，香港婦女參政網絡主席，六四新生代秘書長，支聯會常委，香港市民捍衛人權陣線發言人。）
With your contributions, we will be able to set a positive example for #MeToo victims by raising awareness about women’s and children's rights, globally.
因您的資助，我們將能夠為#MeToo運動傷害者們建立一個積極的個案，為提高女性及孩童的權利意識而有所貢獻。

content:
Fundraiser by Boston Standswithhk : US Hong Kong Safe Harbor Postcard Campaign
Boston Standswithhk is organizing this fundraiser.
***When donation, make as anonymous if you wish to hide the donator's name and make the TIPS to 0.00***
While US-China tensions continue to escalate and the November presidential elections loom near, as Hongkongers living in the United States (or any informed person in the world), we must not forget or turn a blind eye to the CCP’s continuous oppression on Hongkongers and other minority groups in China, such as Uyghurs, Tibetans, and Mongolians. With the promulgation of the new National Security Law on June 30, 2020, the government has since been arresting and charging dissidents with these vaguely-worded laws that may entail life imprisonment. In the past month alone, 12 Hong Kongers fleeing protest-related charges have been detained in China and denied meetings with lawyers since August 23, 2020; Legislative Council elections had been postponed a year in the name of “public health concerns” amidst a mass arrest of candidates; media mogul Jimmy Lai, who runs the only pro-democratic print newspaper in Hong Kong, has been arrested with the National Security Law; and the Education Bureau has begun actively censoring content they deemed politically incorrect in Liberal Studies textbooks, including concepts like “civil disobedience” and “separation of powers”, and images of Lennon Walls. Up until today, the administration has arrested more than 10,000 Hong Kongers, charged over 2,200, deployed water cannons, fired more than 16,000 tear gas canisters and over 10,000 rubber bullets against its own people. Freedom of speech, freedom of assembly and political rights as we knew it have been thoroughly eroded.
11月的美國總統大選逐漸逼近，中美關係日漸緊張，作為居住在美國的香港人或是在這個世界上任何有良知的人，面對中共對香港、維吾爾族、藏族和蒙古族的持續壓逼，我們不能容忍，更不能視而不見。自2020年6月30日頒布《國家安全法》以來，政府持續逮捕異見人​​士，並以措辭含糊的法律起訴抗爭者，香港的司法制度已經徹底淪為政府的打壓工具。及後更有12名香港抗爭者為了逃離這種不公義的審判欲流亡台灣，卻被中共非法拘捕。他們無法與律師會面，音訊全無。而香港人僅有的發聲方法——立法會選舉，卻因為「公共衛生風險」而被推遲一年；同時間，大批候選人被逮捕或是被拒絕參選。作為香港唯一異見紙媒《蘋果日報》的老闆黎智英被警方高調逮捕，《蘋果日報》總部更被大肆搜查。教育局亦積極審查通識科教科書中所謂的「政治不正確」內容，例如「公民抗命」和「三權分立」的概念，以及連儂牆相片。到今天為止，已經有超過10,000多名香港人被捕、2,200多人被起訴，警方向市民發射了超過16,000枚催淚彈和10,000多發橡皮子彈，令香港人長期生活在恐懼中。香港人的言論自由、集會自由和政治權利已被徹底侵蝕。
In light of the deteriorating situation, we plan to kickstart a new round of postcard campaign urging Congress to pass two bills related to Hong Kong as soon as possible - Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act (H.R.7415/S.4110), and Hong Kong People’s Freedom and Choice Act (H.R.7428/S.4229):
鑑於情況日益惡化，我們希望透過郵寄明信片給國會議員的方式，呼籲他們盡快通過兩項與香港有關的法案 —— 香港安全港法案 (H.R.7415 / S.4110) 和香港人民自由與選擇法(H.R.7428 / S.4229):
The Hong Kong Safe Harbor Act will designate certain Hong Kong residents who are victims of persecution or who have a well-founded fear of future persecution because of their peaceful political activities as Priority 2 refugees (excluded from refugee cap), allowing them and their spouses, children, parents to apply to the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program for protection. (Click here for more details)
《香港安全港法案》將指定某些遭受迫害，或因其參與和平的政治活動而感到恐懼的香港居民列為「優先級別2」的難民，且不受每年限額限制，亦允許他們及其配偶、子女、父母向「美國難民接納計劃」申請庇護。(詳情請瀏覽)
The Hong Kong People's Freedom and Choice Act will provide Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for Hong Kongers, maintain Hong Kong’s status as autonomous for the purposes of immigration, provide special and expedited status for certain high-skilled Hong Kongers as well as expedite Permanent Resident status for Hong Kongers residing in the US. (Click here for more details)
《香港人民自由與選擇法》會為香港人提供臨時保護身份（TPS），維持香港在移民方面的自治地位，亦為部分香港專業人仕提供特殊和快速的身份，並加快辦理香港人的美國永久居民(綠卡)身份的程序。(詳情請瀏覽)
In our last postcard campaign pushing for the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act, we delivered over 3000 postcards to Congress. We aren’t part of any formal organization and do not have operation funds. content:
民主党将如何努力结束特朗普的关税
民主党人准备在下一届国会掌权后立即挑战唐纳德·特朗普总统的标志性关税政策。
民主党领导人计划加快立法进程，重申国会对贸易的权威。
众议员杰米·拉斯金(Jamie Raskin)等民主党人也在为启动关税相关调查奠定基础。
特朗普的关税已经面临压力：它们在多起诉讼中受到挑战，一些共和党人已经与对加拿大和其他国家的关税保持距离。
2026 年 8 月 5 日，位于华盛顿特区的美国国会大厦。
亚伦·施瓦茨 |彭博社 |盖蒂图片社
国会之争已经结束。围绕唐纳德·特朗普总统关税的战争即将升温。
随着民主党准备对共和党总统的标志性政策动用新的立法火力，特朗普过去两年编织的关税网可能很快就会面临最大的威胁。
民主党人毫不掩饰他们计划在下一届国会宣誓就职后立即对特朗普及其同伙进行调查。他们还准备发起首个100小时的立法闪电战，提出一系列法案，以消除特朗普的大部分议程。
两方面的攻击都将针对特朗普前所未有地使用关税，民主党在周二中期选举中取得压倒性胜利后，很快将关税确定为主要目标。

拉斯金要求提供捐赠记录，称特朗普正在利用关税作为“行贿工具”
本周的蓝潮选举会迎来2028年民主党总统吗？
法官要求前美国检察官调查政府是否在特朗普高尔夫案中误导了她
密歇根州民主党参议员当选参议员阿卜杜勒·埃尔·赛义德周四对 MS NOW 的《早安乔》节目表示，结束特朗普的关税制度，特别是他对加拿大的贸易战，是民主党人“绝对必须立即采取的行动”。
纽约州众议员哈基姆·杰弗里斯（Hakeem Jeffries）是民主党少数党领袖，可能在下届国会当选众议院议长，他明确表示，结束特朗普的关税是当务之急。
他在八月底的新闻发布会上表示：“我们应该恢复国会在关税方面的权威，因为特朗普的关税让美国人民的生活变得更加昂贵。”
如果被选为议长，杰弗里斯将加快立法进程，重申国会对贸易的权威。
民主党人还在为调查特朗普的关税奠定基础，该党将关税纳入其获胜的竞选信息中，将高成本与所谓的特朗普世界腐败联系起来。
众议院司法委员会民主党领袖、马里兰州众议员杰米·拉斯金 (Jamie Raskin) 10 月 28 日要求特朗普交出与关税豁免相关的记录。拉斯金声称，特朗普利用豁免权，为那些领导人不断向总统赠送礼物的行业达成“甜心交易”。
文件照片：2026 年 11 月 2 日，唐纳德·特朗普总统在中期选举前抵达华盛顿特区林肯纪念堂倒影池发表讲话，该倒影池经过数月的维修后重新开放。
这些计划可能会加剧特朗普关税已经面临的法律和政治压力。
政府已经卷入了多起针对不同部门的诉讼。

【原文 English Original】
How Democrats will try to end Trump's tariffs
Democrats are preparing to challenge President Donald Trump's signature tariff policy as soon as they take power in the next Congress.
Democratic leaders plan to speed legislation to the House floor that reasserts Congress' authority over trade.
Democrats such as Rep. Jamie Raskin are also laying the groundwork to launch tariff-related investigations.
Trump's tariffs were already under pressure: They are being challenged in multiple lawsuits, and some Republicans have distanced themselves from the duties on Canada and others.
The U.S. Capitol in Washington, D.C., on Aug. 5, 2026.
Aaron Schwartz | Bloomberg | Getty Images
The battle for Congress is over. The war over President Donald Trump's tariffs is about to heat up.
The knotted web of tariffs that Trump spent the last two years weaving could soon face its biggest threat, as Democrats prepare to unload their new legislative firepower against the Republican president's signature policy.
Democrats have made no secret of their plans to bombard Trump and his associates with investigations as soon as the next Congress is sworn in. They are also preparing a first-100-hours legislative blitz, putting forward a series of bills that would unwind much of Trump's agenda.
Both prongs of attack will take aim at Trump's unprecedented use of tariffs, which Democrats have quickly identified as a main target following their landslide victory in Tuesday's midterm elections.
Read more CNBC politics and policy coverage
Democrats plan to challenge Trump's tariffs, starting with Canada
Trump is using tariffs as a 'tool for grift,' Raskin says in demand for donor records
Will this week's blue wave election usher in a Democratic president in 2028?
Judge wants former U.S. attorney to investigate whether the government misled her in Trump golf case
Ending Trump's tariff regime, and especially his trade war against Canada, is something Democrats "absolutely have to do immediately," Sen.-elect Abdul El-Sayed, D-Mich., told MS NOW's "Morning Joe" Thursday.
Rep. Hakeem Jeffries of New York, the Democratic minority leader who could be elected House speaker in the next Congress, has made clear that ending Trump's tariffs is a top priority.
"We should restore congressional authority as it relates to tariffs, because the Trump tariffs are making life more expensive for the American people," he said at a press conference in late August.
If picked as speaker, Jeffries would speed legislation to the House floor that reasserts congressional authority over trade.
Democrats are also laying the groundwork for investigations into Trump's tariffs, which the party folded into its winning campaign message linking high costs with alleged Trumpworld corruption.
Rep. Jamie Raskin of Maryland, the top Democrat on the House Judiciary Committee, on Oct. 28 asked Trump to hand over records related to tariff exemptions. Trump, Raskin alleges, has wielded the exemption power to cut "sweetheart deals" for industries whose leaders have plied the president with gifts.
FILE PHOTO: President Donald Trump arrives to deliver remarks, ahead of the midterm elections at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, after being reopened following months of repairs, in Washington, D.C., November 2, 2026.
The plans are likely to ratchet up the pressure, both legally and politically, that Trump's tariffs were already facing.
The administration is already embroiled in multiple lawsuits challenging different parts of the government's tariff policy.
The most recent suit, filed Oct. 20, targets Trump's use of a Great Depression-era law to impose 50% tariffs on a range of Canadian goods.
Another court case accuses Trump of trying to recreate the near-global "liberation day" tariffs that the Supreme Court struck down as illegal in late February. The administration has since been ordered to refund $166 billion in tariff revenue it had collected under the scrapped policy.
Congress, not the president, holds the power to levy taxes under the U.S. Constitution. Over decades, the legislative branch has ceded some of those powers to the executive. But Trump has asserted virtually unchecked tariff powers – which Democrats say they are intent on clawing back.
"Every day Trump insists on his indiscriminate taxes on so many of the products Americans need, he digs a deeper hole for Republicans enabling his tariff spree," said Sen. Ron Wyden of Oregon, who is poised to lead the Senate Finance Committee when Democrats take it over.
"If Democrats somehow had a veto-proof majority, or if voters shame Republicans into doing the right thing, there would be no shortage of trade policies to address," Wyden said in a statement to CNBC before Election Day.
"One of the most obvious priorities would be repealing Trump's tariffs on Canada, which are raising prices and harming communities on both sides of the border," he said. "I'll also continue to work to ensure Congress has the final say on tariffs, so future presidents can't reenact Trump's economically disastrous trade taxes."
The Wall Street Journal, citing Wyden, reported Thursday that Democrats are eyeing the Canada trade war as the "first target" in their efforts against his tariff agenda.
As Wyden's statement suggested, the Senate's rules will hamper Democrats' anti-tariff efforts.
Despite their blowout victory Tuesday night, the party will still lack a 60-vote filibuster-proof majority in the Senate, giving Republicans a crucial tool to block legislation even in their diminished state.
Trump is also poised to lean heavily on his veto pen in the next Congress, presenting a major obstacle for Democrats' legislative priorities.
Overriding a presidential veto requires two-thirds majorities in both the House and Senate, meaning that even with their historic electoral gains, Democrats would need significant Republican help to force a bill into law over Trump's objection.
Democrats may consider it worthwhile to pass legislation even if Trump vetoes it, as doing so could help them build political narratives in the 2028 election cycle. But they may have other options available.
"Absent the brute force of a veto-proof coalition, Congress might consider other political solutions, such as adding riders on 'must-pass' bills or negotiation with the administration," Kit Johnson, a senior tax manager for BDO's customs and international trade group, told CNBC in an email.
Trump has said he plans to use the veto power to force Democrats to the negotiating table. But when it comes to tariffs, it's hard to imagine what deal Trump might accept.
Trump has tried to reshape U.S. trade, foreign and economic policy around his asserted power to slap steep duties on imported goods. He describes tariffs as a win-win, praising them as both a powerful negotiating tool and a major revenue generator.
After Tuesday's election, Trump seemed to suggest tariffs were non-negotiable.
"If I took tariffs off — we have 3,000 plants under construction right now. Every single plant would stop building," Trump told CNBC's Eamon Javers in a phone call Wednesday.
Since taking office in January 2025, Trump has hiked tariffs on nearly every country on the planet, leading to multiple protracted trade wars, most notably against Canada and China. He insists Americans do not share the burden of the duties, even though tariffs by definition are taxes on foreign goods paid by those importing them. The nonprofit Tax Foundation estimates Trump's tariffs have raised the average U.S. household's tax burden by $820 in 2026.
Trump has also consistently overstated the amount of revenue the government has amassed through his tariffs. He claimed before Election Day that tariffs enabled him to offer every U.S. adult $5,000 "dividend" checks if Republicans were to win both chambers of Congress – a plan that would cost roughly $1.2 trillion. But the duties – which are collected from U.S. importers – have only brought in around $300 billion in total between January 2025 and July 2026, according to the Penn Wharton Budget Model.
What's more, about $138 billion of that total has been refunded since the Supreme Court ruling in February. Nearly $20 billion in tariff collections are still set to be refunded.
Most voters do not share Trump's rosy view of tariffs. Sixty-five percent of respondents to the CNBC Voter Poll on Nov. 3 said the duties have hurt the U.S. economy, while just 22% say they helped.
What remains to be seen is how hard Republicans in Congress will push back on Democrats' efforts.
A number of GOP lawmakers came out against the duties during the campaign, as their opponents gained ground blaming inflation on Trump's tariffs and the Iran war.
As they try to regroup and look forward to the 2028 election cycle, some Republicans – who largely supported free trade prior to Trump's political rise – may be less willing to continue aligning themselves with Trump's aggressive protectionism.

content:
尽管官方冻结，台北香港主题义卖仍促进联系 - 聚焦台湾
尽管官方冻结，台北香港主题集市仍促进联系
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
周日，游客在台北华山 1914 创意园区的香港主题集市上浏览摊位。中央通讯社照片2026年11月8日
台北11月8日电（中央社）本周末在台北举行的香港主题集市将移民和台湾游客聚集在一起，突显了在官方接触减少的情况下香港和台湾人民之间持续的联系。
第四届年度活动于周六和周日在华山 1914 创意园区由政府资助的台港经济文化合作协会 (THEC) 举办，共有 70 个摊位出售港式食品和创意产品。
四年前移居台湾、现在从事花店工作的香港人乔乔·文(Jojo Man)表示，她第三年回来是为了与同胞们重新建立联系。
周日，香港移民文乔乔在台北香港主题集市的摊位上摆着手工制作的鲜花和包装好的汤料。中央通讯社照片2026年11月8日
“对我们来说，赚钱是第二位的，”卖鲜花和港式汤的文说。
她说，台湾顾客对不熟悉的汤料的好奇心也创造了分享不同文化的机会。
“我觉得这样的交流很有趣。”文说，他鼓励香港移民了解当地习俗，找到平衡点，而不是不断抱怨差异。
40 多岁的香港出生软件工程师 Ian Yip 在台湾生活了二十多年，他表示台湾人越来越接受香港人。
周日，叶先生在台北的香港主题集市上分享了他作为在台湾生活了二十多年的香港人的经历。中央通讯社照片2026年11月8日
他回忆说，早年在台湾时，他兼职的高尔夫球场的一些顾客告诉他不要接近，因为他们“不喜欢香港人”。他说，一些台湾人认为香港人缺乏耐心并且过度关心金钱。
叶说，这些年来，这种刻板印象已逐渐消失，他希望像义卖这样的活动可以帮助台湾人通过直接互动更好地了解香港人。
近年来，香港和台湾之间的官方交流有所减少，特别是在 2019 年大规模民主抗议活动和北京于 2020 年实施国家安全法之后。
香港于 2021 年暂停了其驻台北代表处的运营，而台湾驻香港代表处则在台湾官员放弃了自 2018 年开始的涉及北京“一个中国”原则的签证纠纷后，继续聘用当地员工开展业务。
在此背景下，叶先生强调了民心相通的重要性，并鼓励香港人带台湾朋友来义卖，而不仅仅是自己参加。
“这就是交流真正发生的方式，”他说。
33 岁的台湾游客 Bill Tai 今年已访问香港五次，他表示，他被集市上的美食以及对香港文化（尤其是他正在学习的粤语）的兴趣所吸引。
周日，台湾游客戴志明在台北的香港主题集市上展示了他的带有台湾和香港主题装饰的背包。中央通讯社照片2026年11月8日
戴秉国表示，香港的政治变化使其陷入困境。

Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei fosters ties despite official freeze - Focus Taiwan
Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei fosters ties despite official freeze
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Visitors browse stalls at a Hong Kong-themed bazaar at Huashan 1914 Creative Park in Taipei on Sunday. CNA photo Nov. 8, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 8 (CNA) A Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei this weekend brought immigrants and Taiwanese visitors together, highlighting ongoing ties between people from Hong Kong and Taiwan amid dwindling official contacts.
The fourth annual event, held Saturday and Sunday at Huashan 1914 Creative Park by the government-funded Taiwan-Hong Kong Economic and Cultural Co-operation Council (THEC), featured 70 stalls selling Hong Kong-style food and creative products.
Jojo Man, a Hongkonger who moved to Taiwan four years ago and now works as a florist, said she returned for a third year to reconnect with fellow immigrants.
Hong Kong immigrant Jojo Man poses with handmade flowers and packaged soup ingredients at her stall at a Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei on Sunday. CNA photo Nov. 8, 2026
"For us, making money comes second," said Man, who sold flowers and Hong Kong-style soups.
She said Taiwanese customers' curiosity about unfamiliar soup ingredients also created opportunities for sharing different cultures.
"I find such exchanges quite interesting," said Man, who encouraged Hong Kong immigrants to understand local customs and find a balance rather than constantly complain about differences.
Ian Yip, a Hong Kong-born software engineer in his 40s who has lived in Taiwan for over two decades, said Taiwanese have become more accepting of Hongkongers.
Ian Yip shares his experiences as a Hongkonger who has lived in Taiwan for more than two decades at a Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei on Sunday. CNA photo Nov. 8, 2026
He recalled that during his early years in Taiwan, some customers at a golf course where he worked part-time told him not to approach because they "didn't like Hongkongers." Some Taiwanese saw Hongkongers as impatient and overly concerned with money, he said.
Yip said such stereotypes had gradually faded over the years, and he hoped events like the bazaar could help Taiwanese better understand Hongkongers through direct interaction.
Official exchanges between Hong Kong and Taiwan have dwindled in recent years, particularly following mass pro-democracy protests in 2019 and Beijing's imposition of a national security law in 2020.
Hong Kong suspended operations at its representative office in Taipei in 2021, while Taiwan's office in Hong Kong continues to operate with locally hired staff after Taiwanese officials left over a visa dispute involving Beijing's "one China" principle that began in 2018.
Against this backdrop, Yip emphasized the importance of people-to-people ties and encouraged Hongkongers to bring Taiwanese friends to the bazaar rather than only take part themselves.
"That's how exchanges can really happen," he said.
Taiwanese visitor Bill Tai, 33, who has visited Hong Kong five times this year, said he was drawn to the bazaar by its food offerings and his interest in Hong Kong culture, particularly Cantonese, which he is learning.
Taiwanese visitor Bill Tai shows off his backpack featuring Taiwan and Hong Kong-themed decorations at a Hong Kong-themed bazaar in Taipei on Sunday. CNA photo Nov. 8, 2026
Tai said political changes in Hong Kong had made it difficult for residents to "speak freely," and welcomed Hongkongers seeking to build new lives in Taiwan, which he described as a relatively freer society.
THEC Secretary-General Lu Chang-shui (盧長水) said the bazaar aimed to encourage people to "respect one another's differences" and help immigrants put down roots in Taiwan.
More than 13,000 Hong Kong and Macao immigrants have obtained Taiwanese citizenship since 2019, said Lu, who also heads the Mainland Affairs Council's Department of Hong Kong, Macao, Inner Mongolia and Tibet Affairs.
According to Lu, the event recorded nearly 67,000 visits Saturday, compared with nearly 90,000 across last year's two-day event.

周末版《世界报》头版内容相当丰富，关注焦点多元。头条报道的是法国高中生的运动持续；头版配图新闻关注的是斯蒂芬·米勒（，美国总统特朗普的忠实顾问，一位被指热衷于阴谋论的人，将接替苏西·威尔斯的职位，出任白宫幕僚长，此举被视为共和党试图转移人们对11月3日中期选举失利的注意力的孤注一掷之举。 即将开幕的土耳其联合国气候峰会以及法国总统大选相关议题也都在内文有不同篇幅的的报道。

**法国高中生抗议继续 _“_ 球在政府那边”**

关于高中生的运动，在内版的报道中指出，在核心的几所高中，抗议活动依然激烈，这些学校在持续一个半月的运动后，仍然受到干扰或被封锁。但仍然继续。学校门前再次出现封锁事件，尤其是在法兰西岛大区和主要城市，这不仅在学生之间引发了摩擦，也加剧了家长之间的矛盾。一些家庭的焦虑情绪日益加剧，部分学校课程已经中断了一个月之久。与此同时，高中毕业会考和法国大学申请平台（Parcoursup）的截止日期临近，远程学习方案的选择也受到限制，即便能够实施，也难以实现。

法国家长联合会（FCPE）虽然支持这场运动，但并不赞同封锁行动，他们认为 _“_ 球在政府这边”。总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努计划于11月9日星期一再次与学生组织会面。现在的局面是，一方面是预算资源有限、任期仅剩六个月的政府，另一方面是积极动员起来的高中生，他们要求采取比行政部门承诺的更迅速、更实质性的措施，双方之间的差距仍在不断扩大。面对这种僵局的风险，仍在积极动员的高中教职工们正努力寻找摆脱危机的出路。

**中国受困于规模过大且具有掠夺性的产业**

在观点版面，有一篇由是巴黎政治学院、布鲁塞尔布鲁盖尔研究所和华盛顿彼得森国际经济研究所的经济学教授让·皮萨尼-费里（Jean Pisani-Ferry ）撰写，题目为“中国缺乏能够纠正其长期失衡的宏观经济战略”的文章值得一读。

这位经济学家在《世界报》的专栏中指出，中国受困于规模过大且具有掠夺性的产业，这对世界其他地区有害；同时，中国面临服务业疲软，房地产行业也疲弱的局面。

文章回顾，二十年前，中国依靠外资实现了工业现代化，迈向高端市场，并学会了按照国际标准制造汽车。而如今，欧洲却需要中国的直接投资来生产电池和电动汽车。这种惊人的逆转并非仅限于汽车行业：中国第一条高铁线路早在2008年就已建成，但到2025年底，中国高铁网络总里程将达到5万公里，是欧洲高铁网络总里程的四倍。

另一方面，中国缺乏的是能够纠正长期失衡的宏观经济战略：工业占国内生产总值的四分之一，而法国仅为10%，工业发展过度，服务业则相应发展不足；经济增长长期以来由基础设施和房地产投资驱动，现在几乎完全由出口和家庭消费驱动，然而家庭消费仅占GDP的40%。低于法国的54%和美国的68%。

作者认为，自2021年房地产泡沫破裂以来，中国经济一直受到通缩的影响，但这种调整何时结束仍遥遥无期。根据国际货币基金组织的数据，人民币兑美元汇率被低估了15%至20%。至于持续攀升的公共部门债务，如果将地方政府的借贷工具考虑在内，到2026年底，其占GDP的比重将达到135%，高于法国的水平。

这些失衡问题由来已久，相应的解决方案也早已存在。二十年来，国际货币基金组织（IMF）在一份又一份的报告中建议中国经济向消费型经济再平衡发展；中国政府也一直默许这一建议；然而，二十年来，这一共识却始终未能转化为实际行动。今年6月，在法国担任主席国期间于埃维昂（上萨瓦省）举行的七国集团峰会再次呼吁拥有巨额对外贸易顺差的国家解除对私人需求增长的限制。然而，中国的对外贸易顺差仍在持续增长：根据IMF的最新预测，到2026年，这一数字将达到GDP的4%。

这种盈余需要采取纠正措施。为什么这些措施没有得到落实？第一个原因显然在于赤字国家和盈余国家之间的不对称性。凯恩斯早在1941年就指出，调整“对债务国是强制性的，对债权国是自愿的”。这一观点在今天依然适用，尤其适用于中国。

但还有其他原因。由于无法将储蓄投资于金融市场，也无法因资本管制而将其转移到国外，中国家庭已将约70%的财富投资于房地产，并因此遭受了巨额损失。据各方估计，房地产资产贬值幅度在20%至40%之间。因此，他们被迫大幅削减消费以补充应急储蓄。由于他们无法依靠子女或严重不完善的养老金体系，这种资金消耗更加严重。

**毫无作为**

然而，中国的经济政策对纠正这种失衡毫无作为。第十五个五年规划非但没有让家庭对储蓄前景放心，也没有提高工资收入在增加值中所占的比重，更没有构建名副其实的社会保障体系，反而致力于促进出口，加大对“六大网络”（电力、电信和其他基础设施）的投资。

作者指出，中国国家主席习近平及其团队既无法摆脱重商主义，也无法摆脱对投资的过度迷恋。

但也并非思路匮乏。10月，智库中国金融四十人论坛（CF40）发布了一份报告，指出需要为中国的发展战略构建“新范式”。报告对经济衰退周期即将结束的乐观态度略显牵强，但其强调消费、服务业发展、社会保障以及资本收入与劳动收入再平衡等观点值得肯定。

文章最后指出，中国的问题也是我们的问题。中国在全球经济中举足轻重的地位，使其自身无法解决的困境必然会影响到我们。为了避免滑向威胁我们的保护主义深渊，世界需要中国充分认识到自身面临的挑战，并提出切实可行的解决方案。

生于中国，在澳大利亚生活近二十年，萧邦是澳大利亚广播公司亚太新闻部的一名获奖记者，现任ABC中文主编。
他在过去十年来长期报道和分析中国政治，包括网络审查、人权记录，以及中共错综复杂的外交政策。他密切关注中国在香港、新疆和两岸方面的重大事件，以及澳中关系的发展动向。
2021年，他凭借对澳大利亚非法签证担保与系统性剥削的调查报道，赢得墨尔本新闻记者俱乐部颁发的羽毛笔奖（Quill Award）“多元文化事务报道”奖。

content:
图像加注文字，枪击案发生隔天早上，克拉科夫中央市集广场仍被警察封闭。
Author, 佛罗伦斯·弗里曼（Florence Freeman）
Author, 艾默·莫罗（Emer Moreau）
在波兰第二大城市克拉科夫（Krakow）市中心，一名疑与极右翼有关的枪手开火，至少六人丧生，另有十多人受伤。
波兰国家检察院克拉科夫分院星期天（11月8日）表示，已就枪击案展开调查。检察官表示，该事件构成“恐怖主义罪行”。波兰内政部宣布全国哀悼两天。
袭击于当地时间星期六（7日）15:00前不久（格林尼治标准时间14:00）在克拉科夫中央集市广场（Main Market Square）开始。这里是该市繁忙的中心地带，也是深受游客欢迎的地点。
警方表示，一名男子驾车驶入广场，然后开始从车内向民众“随机”开枪。
在这宗似乎属于随机性质的袭击中，一辆途经电车遭击中，车窗被打碎，但没有乘客受伤。
Contains some violence, some upsetting scenes and flashing images.
Contains some violence, some upsetting scenes and flashing images. Play video, "波蘭克拉科夫「極右翼」槍擊案致六人死亡", 节目全长 2,51
视频加注文字，BBC波兰语记者玛格达·米兹（Magda Miz）身处克拉科夫。
官员表示，武装警员迅速赶赴现场，并与疑犯驳火。袭击开始三分钟内，疑犯即被击中，从而阻止了进一步的大规模屠杀。
一名被捕的25岁男子因枪伤接受手术后，目前仍在医院留医。
经BBC事实查核（BBC Verify）核实令人不安的片段显示，一名警员在地面上与疑犯对峙，随后多次开枪。
广场上的商店橱窗可见损毁痕迹，似乎是由子弹造成，玻璃碎片散落一地。
市政府官员呼吁居民及游客在调查持续期间远离该区域。
警方表示，在迪耶特拉街（Dietla）与斯特拉多姆斯卡街（Stradomska）交界发现的疑犯汽车已接受爆炸装置检查，但未发现任何爆炸物。行动进行期间，附近建筑物居民一度被疏散。
已确认有六人死亡，包括四名女性及两名男性，其中包括一名英国公民。三名死者是波兰人，另有两人身份尚未确认。
16人被送往医院，包括五名外国公民、两名警员及袭击者本人。波兰内政部其后表示，外国伤者分别来自奥地利、英国、德国、葡萄牙及俄罗斯。
波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克（Donald Tusk）其后公布受伤警员身份，分别为高级警员雅各布·库利克（Jakub Kulik）及高级警员阿图尔·莫兰斯基（Artur Morański）。
一名波兰政府部长表示，其中一名警员在拘捕袭击者时身中三枪，目前情况“极度危殆”。
图斯克表示，警方在枪手住所进行搜查时发现三具遗体，包括两名女性及一名男性。
星期日，波兰警方确认，这三名死者已被确认为涉嫌枪手的父母及其21岁的妹妹。
警方确认袭击者是一名25岁波兰男子，但尚未公布其姓名。
警方发言人表示，疑犯身穿“军事风格服装”，并持有军用级武器，但当局指出他并非军人。
波兰媒体报导，疑犯持有枪械许可证，并可能从其家族住所取得有关武器。
一名部长表示，初步调查显示，他受到“极右翼意识形态”启发。
该名部长亦形容他是“极端民族主义者”，但未有提供更多细节。
其位于奥斯特罗维茨—希维恩托克日斯基（Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski）的住所已遭搜查。该市距离克拉科夫约200公里（125英里），反恐警察亦参与了行动。
枪击发生在欧洲最大的中世纪广场之一。该地点人流繁忙，也是热门旅游目的地。
来自英国伊普斯威奇（Ipswich；叶士域治）的乔纳森·巴尔肖（Jonathan Balshaw）当时与其波兰女友多米尼卡（Dominika）身处现场。枪击发生时，两人正在广场一角的圣母圣殿（St Mary's Basilica）外。
乔纳森表示：“我们沿着教堂旁边奔跑，穿过侧门进去，与其他几人一起躲藏，直到枪声平息。”
“开了很多枪，超过20响，而且听起来像是来自多种不同枪械，有两种明显不同的声音。”
来自纽卡斯尔（Newcastle；纽卡素）的凯特琳·沙斯比（Caitlin Shasby）星期五（6日）与朋友乔恩（Jon）抵达克拉科夫，度过一个长周末假期。
她表示，两人在酒店房间里听到枪声，但起初不知道发生什么事，直到酒店致电通知他们，要“留在房间内，直至另行通知”。
总理图斯克前往克拉科夫后表示：“直到现在之前，波兰尚未出现过如此严重的恐怖主义事件⋯⋯这就是我们必须如何称呼这宗在克拉科夫夺去人命的残酷袭击。”
克拉科夫市长武卡什·吉巴瓦（Łukasz Gibała）已签署命令，宣布全市进入哀悼期，将持续至星期三（11日）。
英国首相安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）表示：“我对今天在克拉科夫发生的可怕枪击事件感到震惊和悲痛。”
他补充说：“我与失去亲人的家庭、所有伤者以及所有受这宗毫无意义暴力事件影响的人同在。英国与波兰人民站在一起。”
英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德（Ed Miliband）在社交媒体表示，英国政府对在这宗“骇人听闻的袭击”中丧生的人表示“深切哀悼”。
美国驻波兰大使汤姆·罗斯（Tom Rose）形容事件是一次“野蛮且致命的袭击”。
欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表卡娅·卡拉斯（Kaja Kallas）表示，这宗枪击事件是一场“其影响将远超波兰的悲剧”。
邻国乌克兰总统泽连斯基（Volodymyr Zelensky）形容枪击事件“令人震惊”。
他在社交媒体写道：“我谨代表乌克兰人民，并以我个人名义，向遇难者家属及亲友致以诚挚慰问。”

content:
图像加注文字，Ensito戴着他订制的Labubu牙齿，与收藏中的一个新玩偶合影。
曾几何时，Labubu（拉布布）公仔似乎势不可挡。
无论大人还是小孩，都争相购买装有这些古怪小怪兽的“盲盒”（blind boxes）。这些密封神秘包装每个售价往往达15美元（108元人民币；480元新台币）或以上。
未能抽中心仪款式的人，更愿意在二手市场支付高得多的价格收购。
围绕Labubu的热潮，甚至令一名来自美国北卡罗来纳州、网名为 Ensito 的超级粉丝，于2024年辞去科技行业工作，全职制作 Labubu 相关内容，并远赴意大利和西班牙追寻最新发售产品。
Ensito 至今已花费超过5万美元（36万元人民币；160万元新台币），收藏逾400个 Labubu。他对BBC说，这是一个“说出来都觉得不好意思”的数字。
他甚至请牙医制作了一排仿照Labubu锯齿形牙齿造型的订制假牙，供出席活动时佩戴。
但近月以来，Ensito 过去曾爆红的 Labubu 影片表现明显转弱。
他说：“以前那些影片很快就能突破一万次观看，但现在我连做到这一点都很困难。”
Ensito 如今已把重心转向 Hello Kitty（凯蒂猫／哈啰凯蒂／吉蒂猫）及“捏捏乐”（Squishies，即按压后慢回弹的柔软纾压玩具）等其他潮流产品。
这显示 Labubu 热潮可能正逐渐失去动力。此前，这股风潮曾令母公司泡泡玛特（Pop Mart）的市值超越美国玩具巨头孩之宝（Hasbro）和美泰（Mattel）的总和。
分析人士认为，这家总部设于北京的品牌正难以把短暂的病毒式热潮转化为持久吸引力。
泡泡玛特近日公布，截至9月底止三个月的全球销售额按年下跌最多50%。
中国大陆以外市场的跌幅尤其明显，其中美国市场收入下跌至少70%。
泡泡玛特并非“盲盒”（blind box）概念的发明者，但旗下公仔无疑推动了这种销售模式在全球普及。
从事市场营销的凯特琳·卡尔森（Katelynn Carlson）表示，盲盒带来的吸引力之一，在于它唤起人们儿时拆礼物时的感觉，令收藏过程充满“怀旧感”。
卡尔森透过社交媒体认识 Labubu，目前已收藏36个。她表示，自己早期购入的其中一个 Labubu 属于稀有款式，令整个体验变得“更加刺激”。
2019年推出的 Labubu，是泡泡玛特最成功的玩具系列。这些小怪兽后来成为时尚潮流象征，美国名人金·卡戴珊（Kim Kardashian）及韩国（南韩）女团 Blackpink 成员 Lisa 等名人均曾公开展示相关产品。
Labubu 经常吸引大批顾客排队抢购，热潮甚至一度令泡泡玛特因顾客争抢产品而暂时把相关玩具从英国门市下架。曾有收藏家花费超过15万美元购入一个真人大小的 Labubu。
新加坡国立大学市场学讲师萨默尔·埃尔—哈贾尔博士（Samer El Hajjar）表示，Labubu 其中一个主要吸引力，在于部分款式极难入手。为了抽中心仪款式，不少粉丝会反复购买盲盒，进一步推高热潮。
图像加注文字，凯特琳·卡尔森（Katelynn Carlson）认为，盲盒是“Labubu”热潮中一个令人兴奋的元素。
泡泡玛特目前在30多个国家设有500家门店，并在全球营运2,000部自动贩卖机。这家于2020年在香港上市的公司市值仍接近240亿美元，尽管其股价较去年高位已下跌逾50%，仍然是全球市值最高的玩具企业之一。
埃尔—哈贾尔表示，投资者担心，泡泡玛特的全球成功只是一次病毒式爆红现象，而非由长期顾客忠诚度推动的可持续增长。
对 Ensito 而言，Labubu 的稀缺性显然是推动热潮的重要因素。
他说：“现在已经没有那种感觉了。我走进泡泡玛特门店，整个 Labubu 系列都放在那里。”
中国市场研究公司超赞（ChoZan）创办人艾熙丽（Ashley Dudarenok）表示，随着泡泡玛特为满足市场需求而大幅提高产量，那种独特和稀有的感觉亦逐渐消失。
泡泡玛特拒绝评论股价表现，亦未有回应有关销售下跌的提问。
随着 Labubu 热潮降温，其部分竞争对手反而变得愈来愈受欢迎。
Sonny Angel——一种赤身裸体、宛如小天使般的玩偶——等盲盒收藏品，以及夜光 Smiski 迷你公仔近期持续热卖。如今，就连小马宝莉（My Little Pony；彩虹小马）及Kpop 猎魔女团（KPop Demon Hunters）等品牌亦推出了盲盒产品。
总部位于中国广州的名创优品（Miniso），目前在全球超过8,000家门店销售迪士尼（Disney）及漫威（Marvel）角色系列盲盒。
名创优品管理人员黄铮（Vincent Huang）今年较早前表示：“消费者其实并不特别在意品牌来自哪里。”
“他们更关心购物体验，例如设计、性价比，以及购买过程中的乐趣。”
图像加注文字，Pop Mart面临名创优品等零售商的竞争。
专家指出，泡泡玛特面临的最大挑战之一，是能否打造出历久不衰的角色品牌。
分析师布斯塔尼（Boustani）认为，在这方面，Hello Kitty 母公司三丽鸥（Sanrio）明显占有优势。三丽鸥截至今年3月止财政年度录得创纪录业绩。
部分专家认为，泡泡玛特近年已大举投资扩展品牌影响力，包括在北京开设主题乐园，以及宣布开拍 Labubu 电影，做法与迪士尼（Disney）和乐高（Lego）等特许经营巨头相似。
不过，艾熙丽表示，与迪士尼先透过故事塑造角色、再销售玩具不同，泡泡玛特正走相反路线。
她说：“明年真正的考验，是泡泡玛特能否在没有名人加持的情况下，仍然让人们爱上一个角色。”
图像来源，Smith Collection/Gado via Getty Images
图像加注文字，夜光公仔Smiskis成为Labubu的竞争对手。
在花费巨额金钱收藏这些小怪兽后，Ensito 表示，每当有新潮流出现时，他如今开始反思人们究竟投入了多少时间和金钱在收藏品上。
他说：“每年总会出现一股新潮流，总会有一些东西突然变得非常受欢迎。”
来自墨尔本的内容创作者劳伦斯·余（Lawrence Yu）则表示，在追逐 Labubu 两年后，未来若要为自己约50个 Labubu 收藏增添新成员，他很可能会变得“更加挑剔”。
他的 Labubu 购买及开箱影片过去曾录得高达100万次观看，但随着热潮消退，他如今已很少再制作相关内容。
他说：“我确实认为这股热潮已经放缓⋯⋯人们会疯狂追捧一段时间，然后热度就慢慢消散。”
来自加拿大的克拉拉·巴贝罗（Clara Barbero）则认为，Labubu 已经成为一个“过气潮流”，但她仍会留意是否有值得收藏的新产品推出。
她说：“我现在会更有意识地整理自己的收藏，只购买那些我认为未来几年仍然会喜欢的款式，而不是每逢有新系列推出就买。”
图像加注文字，劳伦斯·余（Lawrence Yu）表示，他已经花了大约1400美元购买 Labubu 公仔。
来自利物浦的海蒂·哈立德（Hedy Khaled）表示，尽管这些公仔的热潮正在降温，但她对自己收藏的70个泡泡玛特公仔依然同样喜爱。
她认为，追逐潮流的人与“真正的粉丝”之间存在明显分别，因此销售下滑未必代表 Labubu 已失去吸引力。
对卡尔森而言，让她持续收藏的原因并非一时的网络热潮，而是这些公仔带来的快乐。她至今仍会因泡泡玛特推出的新产品而感到兴奋，例如近期推出的猫咪主题 Labubu 系列，已成为她最喜欢的系列之一。
她说：“我认为，拥抱内心的小孩，并单纯因为某些事物能令自己快乐而去喜欢它，当中有种特别的意义。”

content:
今年年初，柬埔寨全国范围内的打击犯罪行动全面展开图像来源: Chalinee Thirasupa/REUTERS
（德国之声中文网）面对日益增长的国际压力，柬埔寨加大了打击力度，关闭了在该国蓬勃发展的诈骗中心。
今年年初，柬埔寨全国范围内的打击犯罪行动全面展开，导致数万名前诈骗人员流落街头，引发了一场人道主义危机。
美联社采访了前诈骗人员、致力于调查人口贩运的非营利组织和其他专家，揭示了柬埔寨打击行动所造成的危机的严重程度。这些前诈骗人员表示，他们遭遇任意拘押、警方骚扰，并因政府禁止为他们提供住房而被迫露宿街头。近一年过去了，仍有数百人滞留当地。
批评人士指出，许多前诈骗人员是人口贩运的受害者，政府应该对他们进行调查，以查明他们在诈骗园区内是否曾遭受虐待。“政府通常将落入诈骗中心的移民视为罪犯，我们没有看到任何证据表明当局作出了充分努力，按照国际公认的人口贩运识别指标对他们进行筛查。”致力于调查人口贩运的非营利组织Eos Collective的李玲（音译）说道。
在柬埔寨，网络诈骗是一个价值数十亿美元的规模产业。据估计，约有10万名从业人员在戒备森严的大型园区内从事网络诈骗，他们住在宿舍里，不被允许离开。有些人明知自己参与的是非法活动，但许多人是被高薪工作的虚假承诺诱骗，并陷入复杂的人口贩运网络。
据追踪诈骗地点的监督机构 CyberScamMonitor收集的数据，柬埔寨至少有182个已确认的诈骗窝点，但该机构掌握的证据显示实际窝点数量约为300个。
2025年末，一名韩国留学生被迫进入诈骗园区后死亡，以及美国起诉一名出生于中国的柬埔寨企业集团创始人（该集团涉嫌大规模加密货币诈骗），使得此类诈骗活动引起了全球关注。
据估计，约有10万名从业人员在戒备森严的大型园区内从事网络诈骗，他们住在宿舍里，不被允许离开。图像来源: Chalinee Thirasupa/REUTERS
今年9月，柬埔寨宣布已捣毁所有大型诈骗窝点，并正在对与这些诈骗案相关的案件提起诉讼。上个月，柬埔寨表示已从一个涉嫌诈骗网络中查获价值10亿美元的资产，并请求国际刑警组织协助追捕29名团伙头目。
但柬埔寨并未提供任何证据表明，其正在对这些骗局背后的犯罪操盘手，或帮助其发展壮大的柬埔寨政商精英采取行动。这些精英通过提供资金、设施和人脉关系，使诈骗产业风生水起。据美国国会称，其中包括高级政客以及首相洪玛奈的亲属，美国国会已呼吁对其实施制裁。
“他们需要开始追究有证据支持的精英犯罪分子的责任，而不是捏造的、无关痛痒的中层调查，应追究的是那些内阁级成员、参议员以及首相家族成员。”哈佛大学亚洲中心访问学者、跨国犯罪专家雅各布·丹尼尔·西姆斯 (Jacob Daniel Sims) 表示。
柬埔寨新闻部长奈特·帕克特拉 (Neth Pheaktra) 没有回复美联社通过Telegram发送的详细问题，这些问题涉及柬埔寨如何处理诈骗犯，外界要求起诉其高级政客的呼声，以及其正在进行的任何刑事案件。
今年早些时候，在回应美联社有关被打击行动波及的前诈骗从业人员待遇问题时，帕特拉表示，“柬埔寨否认其未能保护人口贩运受害者或容忍与诈骗窝点相关的虐待行为。”他声称，“所有人员都经过筛选，以区分受害者和犯罪者，受害者将获得保护、住所、医疗服务以及安全返回的援助。”但他没有提供任何此类程序的证据。
有些人明知自己参与的是非法活动，但许多人是被高薪工作的虚假承诺诱骗，并陷入复杂的人口贩运网络。图像来源: Chalinee Thirasupa/REUTERS
警方突袭这些窝点后，诈骗犯纷纷逃离，数万人涌入金边。许多前从业人员没有钱购买回国机票，也几乎得不到本国大使馆的帮助。
虽然目前尚无关于有多少诈骗犯离开诈骗园区的完整数据，但来自邻国的报道让我们得以一窥这一群体的规模和多样性。据中国央视报道，中国在6月份表示，已有遣返了2万多名与诈骗园区相关人员被遣返。越南一个边境省份表示，2026年上半年接收了超过1700名前劳工。
印尼大使馆9月份表示，已收到12940名印尼公民的回国援助请求，另有700人仍滞留在柬埔寨。乌干达驻该地区大使表示，已帮助1000名非洲人返回家园。
许多前从业人员的护照被诈骗团伙扣押，并因在柬埔寨逾期滞留、没有有效签证而面临罚款。即便他们有能力支付罚款，柬埔寨政府也已禁止住宿场所向这些前从业人员出租房间。许多人最终流落街头，甚至连着几天没东西吃。
警方还进行了多次清查行动，将前从业人员带往拘留中心。他们必须留在那里，直到能够买到回国机票。两名前从业人员告诉美联社，他们曾被关押在一个名为“芒果2号”（Mango 2）的拘留中心。在那里，他们和前从业人员挤在一起，睡在地上，直到后来获得援助组织提供的回国机票。

Desmond D’Sa was one of seven South African winners of the Goldman Environmental Prize, a global award to inspire grassroots activists to take action to protect the planet. Hundreds of fellow activists and colleagues paid tribute to his life and legacy at a series of memorial services in Durban last week.
Kerwyn Strydom (left) and Eugene van der Byl (centre) were among the hundreds of residents and activists who raised their hands in a farewell tribute to environmental activist Desmond D’Sa at a memorial service at the Austerville Hall in Durban on 5 November. (Photo: Tony Carnie)
He was a “difficult man”, an energetic “bulldozer” who stood up to defend the poor – but was also a kind and spiritual community builder.
These were some of the terms used to describe the late Desmond D’Sa during memorial services at the Austerville Hall and the Christ the King Catholic Church in Wentworth, Durban, last week
D’Sa (70) died in a car crash on the KwaZulu-Natal south coast on 29 October while driving to the offices of the South Durban Community Environmental Alliance (SDCEA), which he helped to establish 30 years ago, mainly to fight for people’s right to clean and healthy air.
Desmond D’Sa charms the crowd at a community meeting in South Durban. (Photo: Goldman Environmental Foundation)
One of 13 children, D’Sa was born in Cato Manor but his family was “dumped” in the mid-1960s into Wentworth, a Group Areas Act residential area surrounded by petrol refineries, chemical factories and a paper mill that spewed tonnes of pollutants into the air daily.
By the 1980s D’Sa had had enough of the polluted air, cramped housing, crime, gangs and drug problems that plagued sections of his community, leading to the establishment of the Wentworth Development Forum.
And when Nelson Mandela visited Wentworth to cut the ribbon for a further expansion of the Engen fuel refinery in 1995, D’Sa and his SDCEA colleagues confronted the newly elected president about the high rates of leukaemia, cancer and asthma in Wentworth, Merebank and the Bluff.
Their protests prompted the formation of an intergovernmental “multipoint plan” to measure air pollution properly and to compel heavy industry in South Durban to progressively reduce poisonous air emissions in neighbouring residential areas.
A policeman and a resident of Wentworth watch flames and smoke pouring from the Engen refinery during a fire in 2020 that led to the evacuation of several neighbouring homes. (Photo: Tony Carnie)
At a memorial service at Austerville Hall on 5 November, Bobby Peek (a fellow activist, Goldman Prize winner and founding director of environmental justice group groundWork) described D’Sa as his “second ballie” (father), a man whose campaigns had extended far beyond Durban to build solidarity with environmental activists in air-polluted neighbourhoods across the country and the world – including Secunda, Sasolburg, Richards Bay, the Niger Delta and the banks of the Mississippi River.
“Desmond often drove many of us mad because he never said ‘no’ to any struggle. No matter what time of day or night, he was ready to hit the road if he believed an injustice was being done.
“Desmond treated me as a son, seeking to pull the line when he thought groundWork was going astray... And he would do that in front of my staff. But I was not embarrassed. I was carefully humbled to remember that I answer to others not to myself.”
Bobby Peek pays tribute to his activist colleague Desmond D’Sa at a memorial service on 5 November. (Photo: Tony Carnie)
Verushka Memdutt, chair of the SDCEA, described D’Sa as the bold, deeply principled “heartbeat” of the alliance.
“He knew every street (in Wentworth and Austerville) and heard every complaint.”
Mqapheli Bonono of the Durban shack dwellers movement Abahlali baseMjondolo remembered D’Sa as a man who “taught us how to organise and how to stand up”.
“He was always on the side of the people. He was always so warm and kind. We always laughed when he was around... (but) he did not back down when struggle became dangerous. Comrade Des spoke fluent isiZulu and engaged everyone with the same respect.”
Desmond D’Sa and members of his family soon after he was named the 2014 winner of the Goldman Environmental Prize. Since the award was established in San Francisco nearly four decades ago, a total of 239 prizes have been awarded globally, including to seven South Africans. Other notable winners include Kenyan activist Wangarĩ Maathai, who later became the first African woman to be awarded the Nobel Peace Prize. (Photo: Goldman Environmental Foundation) Desmond D’Sa (left) leads a protest march by subsistence fishers and other activists in Durban against offshore oil and gas exploration plans along the KwaZulu-Natal coastline. (Photo: Goldman Environmental Foundation)
In his tribute, Pastor Gavin Samuels of the local Church Based Community Organisation, described D’Sa as a “bulldozer with the gift the gab”, who had participated in countless prayer walks through the streets of Austerville and Wentworth.
For SDCEA air quality and health officer Bongani Mthembu, D’Sa was both stubborn and “difficult” at times, but also a second father who had mentored him for 18 years and taught him the need to express his views honestly rather than “just saying things for the sake of things”. DM

content:
中國新時代人民黨11月7日在紐約法拉盛舉行集會，慶祝美國第二個「反共週」，並呼籲眾議院早日通過《法輪功保護法案》（S.4009）。（林丹/大紀元）
【大紀元2026年11月08日訊】（大紀元記者林丹紐約報導）11月7日（週六）上午，中國新時代人民黨在紐約法拉盛舉行第69次例行活動，慶祝美國第二個「反共週」，並呼籲美國眾議院儘快通過參議院版《法輪功與強摘器官受害者保護法案》（S.4009，簡稱《法輪功保護法案》）。他們表示，通過《保護法輪功法案》，就是美國「把反共落到實處」的最大表現之一。
中國新民黨11月7日在法拉盛舉行集會，慶祝美國第二個反共週，呼籲眾議院早日通過《法輪功保護法案》。（林丹/大紀元） 中國新民黨11月7日在法拉盛舉行集會，慶祝美國第二個反共週，呼籲眾議院早日通過《法輪功保護法案》。（林丹/大紀元）
活動現場，眾人打出「熱烈慶祝第二個反共週」、「呼籲美國眾議院早日通過保護法輪功法案」的橫幅，高喊：「打倒共產黨！法輪大法好！通過保護法輪功法案！支持法輪功！消滅共產黨！」。法拉盛中心區緬街（Main St.）人流如織，行人紛紛停下腳步，駐足觀看。
中國新民黨創辦人、活動總協調楊茂森說：「反共是人類的基本底線，是人類的共識，所以我們要堅持下去。感謝法輪功學員、大紀元這些年一直在揭露真相，讓大家看到了共產黨滅絕人性的反人類罪惡。」
「通過《法輪功保護法案》，就是把反共落到實處的最大表現！」楊茂森說.
他說：「共產黨活摘人體器官罪惡滔天，是法輪功學員最早把這個罪惡揭露出來，讓中共反人類罪行天下皆知。活摘器官被稱為最邪惡的侵犯人權的暴行，中共最近幾年甚至把產業鏈搬到了東南亞——中共就是後台。所以，我們呼籲通過《法輪功保護法案》，這是重中之重。對法輪功學員和遭活摘器官的受害者給予保護，對活摘器官的參與者給予制裁，這是把反共落到實處的最大表現。」
談到追究中共侵犯人權的責任，楊茂森說：「把中共推翻以後，要清算中共的罪惡，警醒後世，不能讓這些罪惡再一次在世界上氾濫成災，讓人類的文明得以延續下去。」
中華民國國軍老兵關愛中心董事長胡福慶表示，希望「美國將主要目標對準中共」。他說：「這樣做，美國的政策、策略才對路了，所以不能再猶豫。但是，現在川普政府沒有把主要矛頭對準中共，中共似乎比過去更加活躍。」
他建議說：「所以，《法輪功保護法案》要早點成為法律，儘快地把這個法律立起來，我們今天組織了好多團隊，特地上街，就是要呼籲儘早讓《法輪功保護法案》成為法律。」
中華民國海外公民委員會執行長曹聖華認為，美國設立「反共週」，反映華府已意識到中共對聯合國及國際社會的滲透。他呼籲中國人採取行動反對中共暴政，並主張各國與中華民國建交或復交，「給中共沉重的打擊」。
一些路人看到集會，停下腳步，對「反共週」表達支持。移民美國30多年的馬先生接受採訪說，他呼籲川普總統不要和伊朗這個流氓政權進行談判，「對伊朗，不能打一下就跟它談判。只要這個政權還在，談判有什麼用？等川普不當總統了，它還是要搞核武器。有什麼可談的？應該直接把它消滅掉！」
他還建議說，希望川普以後不要再說「習近平是我的好朋友」。他說：「不管真假，（川普）您說出這話，大家就不愛聽。什麼您的好朋友？他有什麼值得您跟他稱兄道弟的？！」
馬先生說，雖然他每次投票都投給川普，但是他不滿川普訪中並邀請習近平訪美，「還21響禮炮？這一齣，誰不都看在眼裡？能不生氣嗎？！」
中國新民黨11月7日在法拉盛舉行集會，慶祝美國第二個反共週，呼籲眾議院早日通過《法輪功保護法案》。（林丹/大紀元）
川普11月3日簽署總統公告，將2026年11月1日至7日定為美國「反共週」（Anti-Communism Week）。
他在公告中說：「一個多世紀以來，人類的自由一直受到共產主義和社會主義意識形態的威脅——這些意識形態剝奪個人的發展機會，將個人置於國家控制之下，並扼殺自由國家賴以建立的、上帝賦予的權利。值此『反共周』之際，我們再次意識到國家對人類思想、創造力和政治表達的控制所帶來的毀滅性後果——這給數百萬民眾帶來了苦難、貧困、剝削、暴力和悲慘境遇；我們重申，將致力於保護生命、自由和追求幸福這些神聖的價值觀，使其免受暴政枷鎖的束縛。」
川普在公告中還重申：美國建立在持久的信念之上：权利与生俱来，自由是神圣，政府的正當權力來自人民的同意。社會主義、共產主義及激進左翼思潮在美國愈來愈常見，美國人應保持警覺、捍衛美國的原則，記取歷史教訓。
川普表示，在他的領導下，美國永遠不會成為共產主義國家。他承諾捍衛保障自由的憲法、維護個人尊嚴，並鞏固自由市場。
川普呼籲美國人紀念共產主義和社會主義的受害者，捍衛他們曾被剝奪的自由，並守護美國的生活方式，以及生命、自由與追求幸福的權利。
去年11月7日，川普簽署首份「反共週」公告，將2025年11月2日至8日定為反共週。去年公告指出，試圖消滅信仰、壓制自由的政權已奪去逾一億人的生命，並警告冷戰結束後，極權思想仍以新的形式出現。
根據國會記錄，國會參議院於今年9月28日無異議、一致通過《法輪功與強摘器官受害者保護法案》（Falun Gong and Victims of Forced Organ Harvesting Protection Act，S. 4009）。眾議院已經於10月5日收到該法案。
此前，2024年和2025年，由賓州共和黨籍聯邦眾議員斯科特·佩里（Scott Perry）推出的《法輪功保護法案》(Falun Gong Protection Act)，連續兩年在眾議院無異議、一致獲得了通過。
若S. 4009法案成為法律，將要求美國總統制裁明知而直接參與或協助在中國強摘器官的外國人士或實體，措施包括凍結受美國管轄的資產，對相關個人實施簽證及入境限制。

title: 六四纪念馆活动：要求释放香港民主活动人士黄之锋的声援会
source: 六 四 紀 念 館
summary: 近日，香港民主活动人士黄之锋被以“串谋勾结外国势力危害国家安全”罪，于本周四（2026年11月5日）在香港高等法院被判10年监禁。这新增的10年刑期，将令他到2036年才可重获自由，届时他将40岁。 黄之锋是香港现代民主运动的标志性人物，积极投身争取民主普选的社会运动，他是香港民众争取自由民主运动的代表性人物之一。我们强烈谴责这一判决，并要求立即释放黄之锋。 对于黄先生的这一处境，我们深表关切。本馆将于11月14日（周六）下午1：00——3:00举办要求立即释放黄之锋的声援会
content:
近日，香港民主活动人士黄之锋被以“串谋勾结外国势力危害国家安全”罪，于本周四（2026年11月5日）在香港高等法院被判10年监禁。这新增的10年刑期，将令他到2036年才可重获自由，届时他将40岁。
黄之锋是香港现代民主运动的标志性人物，积极投身争取民主普选的社会运动，他是香港民众争取自由民主运动的代表性人物之一。我们强烈谴责这一判决，并要求立即释放黄之锋。
对于黄先生的这一处境，我们深表关切。本馆将于11月14日（周六）下午1：00——3:00举办要求立即释放黄之锋的声援会，诚邀关注香港以及黄之锋状况的各界人士届时共同参加这一声援活动，呼吁立即释放黄之锋以及所有被不公正拘押的人士。
主题：政治抑鬱、集體創傷，及政治避險——從文革、八九、白紙看政治大動盪的社會後遺症 主讲人：王超华（加州大学洛杉矶分校东亚系兼任助理教授） 主持人：王丹（“六四”纪念馆馆长） 时间：2025年6月29日（周日）下午2-4点 免费向公众开放，欢迎参加。 本馆继续呼吁大家参加千人十元计划，帮助我们撑住六四纪念馆的存在：https://reurl.cc/XANzd3 ）
第二届洛杉矶“中国论坛”将在2026年5月31日在六四纪念馆召开。 本届论坛主题：“政治反对运动的跨世代合作” 主 办：“对话中国”智库 此次承办：六四纪念馆，中国民主党全联总 此次协办：《在野党》杂志 时 间：2026年5月31日下午2点 地 点：六四纪念馆 第二届中国论坛邀请了年轻世代和网络世界的代表人物多伦多方脸，以及八九一代的代表人物，《中国民主季刊》主编王天成，一同前来参与。希望通过不同世代的对话，深入探讨“跨世代合作”的原则和操作路径等具有建设性的议题。本届中国论坛，“对话中国”智库将推派年轻成员作为嘉宾出席。 “跨世代合作”能否推进，关系到中国反对运动的发展与前景，此次论坛我们将深入探讨鼓励和支持让年轻世代去多做一些事，让反对运动的跨世代合作从口号变为实际行动。 欢迎各界朋友报名参加第二届中国论坛。
2026年1月18日下午2点至4点，将在六四纪念馆举行集会， 要求释放邹幸彤以及李卓人。 二人均被香港当局关押。此次活动目的是声援他们争取自由和正义的行动。要求当局释放邹幸彤与李卓人。任何悼念天安门死难者的活动都是无罪的，追究屠杀真相及责任是无罪的。 邀请关心香港以及六四真相的各界人士参加。
2月4日晚上7点，“六四”纪念馆将举办电影放映会，是关于八九民运的新的纪录片的美西首映。 纪录片制片主创团队将从华盛顿专程飞到洛杉矶参加放映会，著名媒体人程翔将与制片人进行映后座谈。 欢迎大家参加。 以下是纪录片简介： “在美国新闻业身处险境的时代背景下，这是一段以民主为使命、捍卫真相的新闻故事。 《天安门今夜》 揭示了震撼人心的人性戏剧：丹·拉瑟（Dan Rather）与 CBS《晚间新闻》团队，在生死与声誉的巨大压力下，依然勇敢报道了1989年那场非凡的学生运动——这场运动曾将中国推向民主改革的历史临界点。” English version： Documentary Tiananmen Tonight West Coast premiere in June 4th Memorial Museum US West Coast Premiere: Tiananmen Tonight Film Screening & Director/Producer Q&A Join us for a historic evening at the June 4th Memorial Museum as we host the West Coast premiere of the powerful…
主题：国家为何暴力？我们如何记忆？——王丹新书《六四日志》发布 主讲人：王丹（原八九学生，哈佛大学历史系博士） 嘉宾：张伯笠（原八九学生，现美国华人教会牧师） 主持人：吴祚来 时间：2025年7月19日（周六）下午2-4点 免费向公众开放，当场签售，欢迎参加。 本馆继续呼吁大家参加千人十元计划，帮助我们撑住六四纪念馆的存在：https://reurl.cc/XANzd3

content:

2025 年 9 月 17 日，波兰士兵在波兰奥日什举行的演习中发射“Piorun”便携式防空导弹。（Wojtek Radwanski/法新社，盖蒂图片社）
乌克兰基辅——欧洲官员本周宣布，数千名欧洲军队将于下周聚集在波兰，参加自愿联盟的首次大型军事演习，这是在与俄罗斯的战争结束后向乌克兰部署多国部队的预演。
特使史蒂夫·威特科夫周一表示，此次演习正值美国、俄罗斯和乌克兰谈判代表定于 11 月 10 日至 11 日在阿布扎比举行会议。这次会议为乌克兰和平谈判动荡的一年画上句号。自二月份美国和以色列开始袭击伊朗后，谈判陷入僵局，直到九月份维特科夫和特使贾里德·库什纳在莫斯科会见了普京，然后才以谈判代表身份前往基辅进行首次访问时，谈判才得以恢复。
英国和法国将于 11 月 9 日至 22 日联合领导 KOALICJA 26.2，汇集来自 11 个国家的 2,800 名士兵，在联军的军事力量乌克兰多国部队 (MNF-U) 的领导下，在波兰、法国和土耳其开展协调活动。美国军队不会参加。
英国国防部声明称，演习将联合空中、陆地和海上力量，“测试如何调动、保护和补给一支部队，以便在战斗结束后帮助重建乌克兰武装部队”。
比利时、爱沙尼亚、法国、德国、立陶宛、荷兰、西班牙、瑞典、土耳其和英国也参与其中。
法国外交部的声明称，此次训练将为部队的最终任务做好准备，其中可能包括保护关键基础设施、训练乌克兰军队、帮助保护天空和清除黑海的地雷，这是乌克兰更广泛的安全保障计划的一部分。
英国国防部长韦斯·斯特里廷在国防部新闻稿中表示：“这次演习表明，英国正在加紧与法国和我们的盟友一起，为乌克兰和平到来的那一天做好准备。这不是一个假设的计划；它是一支真正的力量，准备在战斗停止后帮助乌克兰。”
据报道，多国部队将不承担维持和平或停火监督任务，也不接受北约指挥。只有在停火后并应基辅的要求，它才会进入乌克兰。
前法国驻乌克兰大使盖尔·韦西埃尔 (Gaël Veyssière) 在四月份对《军事时报》表示，停火监测“将是一项与多国部队不同的任务，多国部队的目标本质上是不同的，因为它的目的是支持乌克兰军队的能力得到加强”。
据英国发布的消息称，演习还将测试“部队的指挥和控制安排”，并评估“不同组成部分如何作为一支多国部队进行整合和有效运作”。
英国正在派遣 300 名人员，包括来自被称为“沙漠老鼠”的英国陆军第七轻型机械化旅的士兵，来演练后勤行动。华沙将在战后管理多国部队的调动，但不会派遣其部队

European troops set to train in Poland for postwar Ukraine deployment

Polish soldiers fire a “Piorun” MANPAD during exercises in Orzysz, Poland, Sept. 17, 2025. (Wojtek Radwanski/AFP via Getty Images)
KYIV, Ukraine — Thousands of European troops will gather in Poland next week for the Coalition of the Willing’s first major military exercise, a rehearsal for deploying a multinational force to Ukraine once the war with Russia comes to an end, European officials announced this week.
The exercise comes as U.S., Russian and Ukrainian negotiators are set to meet in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10 and 11, special envoy Steve Witkoff said Monday. The meeting caps a tumultuous year for Ukraine’s peace talks, which stalled after the U.S. and Israel began striking Iran in February and revived only in September, when Witkoff and fellow envoy Jared Kushner met Putin in Moscow before traveling to Kyiv for their first visit as negotiators.
Britain and France will jointly lead KOALICJA 26.2 from Nov. 9 to 22, bringing together 2,800 troops from 11 nations for coordinated activities in Poland, France and Turkey under the coalition’s military arm, the Multinational Force-Ukraine (MNF-U). American troops will not participate.
The drills will combine air, land and sea forces to “test how to move, protect and supply a force that would help rebuild Ukraine’s Armed Forces once the fighting ends,” according to a British Ministry of Defence statement.
Belgium, Estonia, France, Germany, Lithuania, the Netherlands, Spain, Sweden, Turkey and Britain are also taking part.
The training will prepare troops for the force’s eventual missions, which could include securing critical infrastructure, training Ukraine’s military, helping protect the skies and clearing mines from the Black Sea, as part of a broader package of security guarantees for Ukraine, according to the French ministry’s statement.
“This exercise shows the UK is stepping up, alongside France and our allies, to prepare for the day peace comes to Ukraine. This isn’t a hypothetical plan; it’s a real force, ready to help Ukraine once the fighting stops,” British Defence Secretary Wes Streeting said in the ministry’s release.
The MNF-U will reportedly not have a peacekeeping or ceasefire-monitoring mandate or operate under NATO command. It would move into Ukraine only after a ceasefire and at Kyiv’s request.
Ceasefire monitoring “would be a different task from that of the multinational force, whose aim is different in nature because it is meant to support the Ukrainian army in its ability to be beefed up,” former French Ambassador to Ukraine Gaël Veyssière told Military Times in April.
The drills will also test “command-and-control arrangements for the force” and assess “how different components can integrate and operate effectively as one multinational force,” according to the British release.
Britain is sending 300 personnel, including soldiers from the British Army’s 7th Light Mechanised Brigade, known as the “Desert Rats,” to rehearse logistical movements. Warsaw will manage the movement of MNF-U troops after the war but will not send its own soldiers into Ukraine. Nearly 2,000 Polish soldiers will take part in addition to the foreign forces, the Polish ministry said.
France is sending “hundreds” of troops, including a unit equipped with about 50 “contact drones,” the second of its kind after one deployed to Romania, Army Chief of Staff Gen. Jacques de Montgros’s told lawmakers last month.
Turkey will not send troops to Poland, the French ministry said, but will stand up the MNF-U’s maritime element in Istanbul, “testing arrangements for maritime mine clearance to allow commercial shipping to safely return to Ukraine’s ports,” according to the British release.
“This exercise will show that the Multinational Force-Ukraine is a real, capable, readily deployable force that represents a serious commitment from Coalition of the Willing nations to Ukraine’s long-term stability and security,” said the commander of MNF-U, British Lt. Gen. Tom Bateman.
The exercise announcements do not specify the final size of a force that could deploy to Ukraine, but Britain and France said earlier this year that they were prepared to contribute roughly 5,000 troops each.
Even a minimal “tripwire” presence would require 10,000 to 25,000 troops, the Center for Strategic and International Studies assessed last year. Because only a third of any force is frontline-ready at a given time, rotations push that number far higher, Ed Arnold, a senior research fellow at the Royal United Services Institute and a former British military officer, told Military Times.
Russian President Vladimir Putin has rejected allowing a foreign troop presence in Ukraine, and he warned in September 2025 that Western forces deployed there would be legitimate targets.
Although the MNF-U is not a peacekeeping force, Polish defense officials said its presence is meant to ease Ukrainian fears of a renewed Russian attack once the war ends.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy pressed allies on Wednesday to move quickly, pointing out that Russian forces continue to batter Ukraine’s power grid and other critical infrastructure as the country braces for its fifth winter of full-scale war.
“Peace has no alternative, and postwar security guarantees must be truly cast-iron,” he said.
Katie Livingstone is the Ukraine correspondent for Defense News and Military Times. Based in Kyiv, she has covered Russia’s full-scale invasion since its first days. She is a former Fulbright fellow whose award-winning work has appeared in outlets across Europe and the U.S.
